title: Register a waste tire facility with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Facilities that collect or store more than 1,000 waste tires, sell waste tires, or retread tires under a U.S. DOT retreader registration register under 6 NYCRR 361-6.3. Facilities outside those provisions need a 361-6.4 permit. Storing fewer than 1,000 tires is exempt.
exemptions: Facilities storing fewer than 1,000 tires

title: Get a New York assisted living residence license
authority: NYS Department of Health
description: An assisted living residence must first be certified as an adult home or enriched housing program, then licensed as an ALR under Public Health Law Article 46-B. Enhanced and special needs certification costs $2,000 for two years ($3,000 for both), non-refundable, per facility, on Form DOH-5093 with plans, financial information, a certificate of occupancy, individual service plans and employee background checks. Renewal is every two years and is not sent automatically; the earlier ALR licence fee is listed at $500 to $5,000.

title: Get a DMV private service bureau license
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles
description: A business that helps the public for hire to get driver licences, or vehicle registrations or titles, needs a private service bureau licence (VTL 395), on Form MV-372 with a $25 fee. It runs July 1 to June 30 and renews for $25 each year. Dealers need it only if they assist the general public beyond their own sales. Processing takes 60 to 90 days for a new licence.
exemptions: Licensed dealers obtaining registrations and titles only for their own customers

title: Get a bottling permit for liquor or wine wholesalers
authority: NYS State Liquor Authority
description: A licensed liquor or wine wholesaler that bottles, re-casts, filters or clarifies, including bulk foreign wine for other wholesalers, needs this three-year permit, $1,460 plus a $20 filing fee. Work must happen at a U.S. customs bonded warehouse or foreign trade zone with a warehouse permit, and a $5,000 penal bond is required.

title: Get an alcohol distributor's Class C permit for wholesale druggists
authority: NYS State Liquor Authority
description: A wholesale druggist that sells and uses alcohol needs this permit under sections 91, 92 and 92-A of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Law. It costs $500 for three years, needs a Liquor Authority warehouse permit and a registered pharmacy, and renews every three years.

title: Register a scrap metal processor or vehicle dismantler with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Storing more than 1,000 cubic yards of metal needs a scrap metal processor registration under 6 NYCRR 361-7.3. Vehicle dismantlers register by size: up to 25 vehicles a year and 50 on site is the small tier, and over that is the large tier. DMV-registered repair shops storing 26 to 50 end-of-life vehicles register, and those over 50 register at the larger tier. Mobile vehicle crushers register separately.

title: Register used cooking oil or yellow grease processing with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Facilities receiving up to 500,000 gallons a year of used cooking oil or yellow grease register under 361-8.3, and larger facilities need a 361-8.4 permit.

title: Get a NYC home improvement contractor license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Anyone doing construction, repair, remodelling or other improvement work on residential land or buildings in New York City needs a DCWP licence, which expires February 28 of odd-numbered years. New applications cost $50 to $200 depending on timing, and renewal is $250. It needs workers' compensation cover, EPA lead certification or an affirmation, and either enrollment in the trust fund ($200) or a $20,000 surety bond. One owner or principal must pass the home improvement exam, and fingerprinting is required.

title: Get a NYC secondhand dealer (general) license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Anyone who buys or sells used goods in New York City needs a DCWP licence, which expires July 31 of odd-numbered years. New applications cost $340 from August 1 of an odd year, $255 from February 1 of an even year, $170 from August 1 of an even year and $85 from February 1 of an odd year. Not-for-profits, garage sales and online-only sales are exempt, and cars, pianos, art, clothing, shoes and some other goods are excluded. No bond or insurance is listed.
exemptions: Not-for-profit organisations, garage sales and sellers dealing exclusively online

title: Get a NYC secondhand dealer (auto) license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses dealing in used cars in New York City need the DCWP secondhand dealer auto licence, which expires July 31 of odd-numbered years. New applications cost $600 from August 1 of an odd year, $450 from February 1 of an even year, $300 from August 1 of an even year and $150 from February 1 of an odd year, plus fingerprinting. No bond or insurance is listed.

title: Get a NYC pawnbroker license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses that lend money on pledged personal property, or buy goods on condition of selling them back at a set price, need a DCWP licence, which expires every April 30. The fee is $500 if filed May 1 to October 30, $250 (or $750 for the longer term) from November 1, and $250 (or $750) from January 1. A $10,000 surety bond naming the City is required.

title: Get a NYC debt collection agency license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Any business collecting personal or household debts from New York City residents needs a DCWP licence, even if located outside the state, including attorneys, law firms and debt buyers. It expires January 31 of odd-numbered years. New applications cost $150 from February 1 of an odd year, $113 from August 1 of an odd year, $75 from February 1 of an even year, and $38 (or $188 for the longer term) from August 1 of an even year. A $5,000 surety bond is needed only if collecting child support.

title: Get a NYC garage or parking lot license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses storing five or more vehicles for a fee in New York City need a DCWP garage, parking lot or combined licence, which expires March 31 of odd-numbered years. For a licence filed April 1 to September 30 of an odd year the fee is $300 for 5 to 25 cars, $380 for 26 to 50, $540 for 51 to 100 and $600 for 101 or more, with lower fees later in the cycle. Property and garagekeepers liability insurance of at least $300,000 combined single limit per accident is required, naming the City as certificate holder; the NYC Business pages list different minimums, so confirm.

title: Get a NYC car wash license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Car washes in New York City need a DCWP licence, which expires October 31 of odd-numbered years. The fee is $550 for a licence filed November 1 of an odd year to April 30 of an even year, with lower and prorated tiers later. A surety bond of $150,000 ($30,000 with a collective bargaining or monitoring agreement), workers' compensation and disability cover, $1 million per occurrence general liability and an unemployment insurance determination letter are required.

title: Get a NYC tow truck company license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses that move or remove disabled, illegally parked, abandoned or accident-involved cars in New York City need a DCWP tow truck company licence, which expires April 30 of even-numbered years. It is charged per truck, $150 to $600 depending on when the application is filed, plus $50 per truck inspection and either a $200 trust fund enrollment or a $5,000 bond. Tow truck liability insurance minimums apply, and drivers are licensed separately.

title: Get a NYC tobacco retail dealer license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Retailers selling tobacco products in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring December 31. The fee is $200 for the full two-year term and $150 for applications filed July 1 to December 31, with community district caps, and pharmacies cannot hold one. It is in addition to the state registration.

title: Get a NYC electronic cigarette retail dealer license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Retailers selling electronic cigarettes in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring November 30. The fee is $200 for the full two-year term and $150 for applications filed June 1 to November 30, with community district caps, and pharmacies cannot hold one. The store must also register with DOHMH, at no fee.

title: Get a NYC self-storage facility license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Self-storage facilities in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring April 1 of even-numbered years. The fee is $590 for applications from April 2 to September 30 of an even year, $443 from October 1, $295 from April 2 of an odd year, and $148 (or $738 for the longer term) from October 1 of an odd year. The enacted Local Law amendments may change the fee structure, so confirm with DCWP.

title: Get a NYC storage warehouse license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses storing consumers' household goods for a fee in New York City need a DCWP storage warehouse licence, expiring April 1 of odd-numbered years. The fee is $590 for applications from April 2 to September 30 of an odd year, $443 from October 1, $295 from April 2 of an even year, and $148 (or $738 for the longer term) from October 1 of an even year. Local Law 171 of 2025 removes the bond requirement from August 25, 2026; storage contracts must state liability cover for consumers' property.

title: Get a NYC third-party food delivery service license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Third-party food delivery services operating in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring August 31 of odd-numbered years. The fee is $200 for a full two-year term, with $150, $100 and $50 tiers for shorter terms and $250 for 30 months. A licence not renewed within 59 days of expiry requires a new application.

title: Get a NYC ticket seller business license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Ticket seller businesses in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring July 31 each year. The fee is $45 if filed August 1 to January 31, and $22.50 (or $67.50 for the longer term) from February 1.

title: Get a NYC scrap metal processor license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses that buy, process and ship scrap metal in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring June 30 each year. The fee is $75 if filed July 1 to December 31, and $38 (or $113 for the longer term) from January 1.

title: Get a NYC industrial laundry license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses laundering for hotels, hospitals, restaurants, gyms and other businesses in New York City need a DCWP licence, and a delivery licence for vehicles delivering the laundry. Both expire December 31 of odd-numbered years. The fee scales with employee count: for a licence filed January to June of an even year it runs from $340 for up to 5 employees to $2,740 for 126 or more, and falls for later windows (the delivery licence has its own schedule). Workers' compensation, disability and $1 million per occurrence general liability are required.

title: Get a NYC construction labor provider license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses supplying construction labour in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring July 31 of even-numbered years. The fee is $200 for applications from August 1 of an even year, $150 from February 1 of an odd year, $100 from August 1 of an odd year, and $50 (or $250 for the longer term) from February 1 of an even year.

title: Get a NYC employment agency license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: In New York City employment agencies are licensed by DCWP rather than the state, with the licence expiring May 1 of even-numbered years. A new licence costs $700 (five or more placement employees) or $500 (one to four) in the main window, with half and quarter tiers later, and renewal is the same. A $5,000 bond is required, or $10,000 for agencies recruiting domestic workers from abroad or running modelling or theatrical agencies.

title: Get a NYC process serving agency license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Process serving agencies in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring February 28 of even-numbered years. The fee is $340 for applications from March 1 of an even year, $255 from September 1, $170 from March 1 of an odd year, and $85 (or $425 for the longer term) from September 1 of an odd year.

title: Get a NYC booting company license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Companies that boot vehicles in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring December 31 of odd-numbered years. The fee is $340 for applications from January 1 of an even year, $255 from July 1, $170 from January 1 of an odd year, and $85 (or $425 for the longer term) from July 1 of an odd year. A $5,000 surety bond naming the City is required.

title: Get a NYC sightseeing bus license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Sightseeing buses in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring March 31 of even-numbered years. The fee is $100 for applications from April 1 of an even year, $75 from October 1, $50 from April 1 of an odd year and $25 (or $125 for the longer term) from October 1 of an odd year. Guides are licensed separately.

title: Get a NYC dealer in products for the disabled license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Dealers of products for people with disabilities in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring March 15 of odd-numbered years. The fee is $200 for applications from March 16 of an odd year, $150 from September 16, $100 from March 16 of an even year, and $50 (or $250 for the longer term) from September 16 of an even year.

title: Get a NYC pedicab business license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Pedicab businesses in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring November 1 each year. The fee is $110 if filed November 2 to May 2 and $55 (or $165 for the longer term) from May 3, with $60 for each extra registration plate and $10 per timer inspection. Business-wide insurance of $2 million combined single limit and per-pedicab policies are required.

title: Get a NYC scale dealer or repairer license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Businesses selling or repairing commercial scales in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring February 28 each year. The fee is $60 if filed March 1 to August 28, and $30 (or $90 for the longer term) from August 29.

title: Get a NYC food service establishment permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Any place in New York City that gives food to people, whether sold or free, needs a DOHMH permit. It costs $280 a year, plus $25 for frozen desserts, and expires one year from the end of the month you applied, with a reminder three months ahead. A supervising manager holding a Food Protection Certificate must be on site, and every permitted establishment gets an unscheduled annual inspection. The business can open 22 days after applying, or earlier after a pre-operating inspection.

title: Get NYC mobile food vending licenses and permits
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Mobile food vendors in New York City need a vending licence and a permit for each unit, both valid two years. Renewal forms are mailed three months before expiry and renewals can be done only in person or by mail. Temporary food service establishments need their own annual permit.

title: Get a NYC tattoo artist license
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: All tattoo artists in New York City must be licensed under the Health Code, with a two-year licence or a temporary licence for operating fewer than 7 days, $50.

title: Get a NYC child care permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Group child care centres in New York City need a DOHMH permit under Article 47 of the Health Code, rather than a state licence. The application fee is $200 and the permit runs up to two years. It needs a DOB certificate of occupancy (or an inspection report), a written safety plan and workers' compensation and disability cover.

title: Get a TLC for-hire vehicle base license
authority: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission
description: A business dispatching for-hire vehicles in New York City needs a TLC base licence. A livery base costs $1,500 for three years plus $75 fingerprinting per person, and must attach at least 10 vehicles, or 5 if one is wheelchair accessible. Outstanding fines or judgments owed to TLC or other agencies must be cleared first.

title: Get a TLC for-hire vehicle license for each vehicle
authority: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission
description: Each for-hire vehicle operating in New York City needs a TLC vehicle licence, $275 a year.

title: Get a TLC high-volume for-hire service license
authority: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission
description: A business dispatching more than 10,000 for-hire vehicle trips a day under one brand in New York City needs a TLC high-volume licence. It lasts two years and the fee is $190,000 a year ($380,000 for two years), non-refundable, due with the application, along with a list of bases and a business plan. The licence is itself a base licence.
exemptions: Dispatchers under 10,000 trips a day

title: Register an electronic waste recycling or consolidation facility with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Electronic waste recycling facilities and consolidation facilities each register through Re-TRAC Connect with a one-time $250 fee under ECL Article 27 Title 26. Collection sites also register.

title: Register as a covered electronic equipment manufacturer with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A manufacturer offering covered electronic equipment for sale in New York registers through Re-TRAC Connect. An individual program pays a one-time $5,000 fee and a collective program registration is $10,000; the manufacturer fee is waived for participants in a collective.

title: File the annual statement with NY DFS as an authorized insurer
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Insurers authorised to do business in New York file an annual statement of their condition at year end by March 1, verified by oath of at least two principal officers (Insurance Law section 307). The Superintendent sets the form, and can grant extensions or exemptions for hardship. DFS enforces the deadlines with civil penalties.
exemptions: Insurers not authorised to do business in New York

title: Get a DEC permit or registration for composting or organics recycling
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Large composting, anaerobic digestion over 50 tons a day and fermentation over 10 tons a day need a Part 361-3 permit, with mid-size and smaller operations registering. Mulch processors register at 10,000 to 25,000 cubic yards on site and need a permit above 25,000. Land application of biosolids and industrial waste is under Part 361-2.

title: Get a DEC bait license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Harvesting and selling minnows, smelt and certain aquatic insects as bait needs a DEC bait licence. Fees run $2 to $30 depending on the method and business location, and it expires December 31, so apply again each year.

title: Get a DEC license to possess and sell protected wildlife
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Possessing or selling protected fish, wildlife, shellfish, crustacea or aquatic insects for propagation, scientific or exhibition use needs a DEC licence, $10 a year. The federal Special Purpose and USDA Commercial Animal Dealer permits come first.

title: Get a DEC fishing preserve license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A landowner with a man-made pond who lets the public fish for a fee needs a fishing preserve licence, $50 a year, renewed annually.

title: Register commercial tax return preparers with the Tax Department
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Commercial tax return preparers register with New York and pay an annual registration fee of $100.
exemptions: Preparers who are not paid to prepare New York returns, such as attorneys, CPAs and enrolled agents who are exempt

title: Register an ATV dealer with DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles
description: Selling all-terrain vehicles needs a DMV dealer registration (VS-1 and related forms), listed at $50 for two years.

title: File for NYSED consent to form a professional corporation or PLLC
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: A practice owned by licensed professionals through a professional corporation or PLLC files with the Education Department after the Department of State. The initial filing is $90 for a domestic professional corporation, $10 per member or manager for a domestic PLLC, and $50 for a foreign corporation (foreign PLLC $50 plus $10 per member), plus a $20 certified copy filing. PLLCs may not provide medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine or several mental health services.
exemptions: Practices that do not use a professional corporation or PLLC

title: File the professional corporation renewal statement with NYSED
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: A domestic professional corporation files a statement every three years, $105, and a foreign professional corporation files every year, $35. Late filings can lead to loss of good standing; check the Renewal/Statement FAQ for timing.
exemptions: Practices organised as PLLCs rather than professional corporations

title: Have a licensed geologist, licensed through NYSED
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Professional geology services require a New York licence. The initial licence fee is $220 and the first registration is $210, $430 in all, and re-registration is $210 every three years. Firms offering geology services need a certificate of authorization.

title: Register or permit a construction and demolition debris facility
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Handling construction and demolition debris needs a 361-5.3 permit, or a 361-5.2(a) registration for facilities under 500 tons a day of masonry, asphalt, shingles, gypsum, wood, soil or fill. C&D debris landfills need a Part 363 permit.

title: Register regulated medical waste treatment or storage with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Healthcare facilities treating, storing or disposing of regulated medical waste from other generators register under 6 NYCRR 365-2.3(c), and generators treating under 500 pounds a month on site register under 365-2.3(b). Radio-pharmacies storing radiological waste also register, and other facilities need a 365-2.4 permit.
exemptions: Facilities that only send their waste off site through a permitted transporter

title: Get a DEC hazardous waste treatment, storage or disposal permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Facilities that treat or store hazardous waste in New York may need an operating permit from the Division of Materials Management, and land disposal facilities need an operating and post-closure permit. Fees are not stated on DEC's page.

title: Get a Part 381 low-level radioactive waste transporter permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Transporters who pick up or deliver low-level radioactive waste in New York, or carry it through the state, need a Part 381 DEC permit.

title: Register a water well drilling business with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Any business drilling water wells in New York must be registered with the DEC Water Well Contractor Program.

title: Get SPDES CAFO permit coverage for a large animal feeding operation
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Large and medium concentrated animal feeding operations, and small ones DEC designates, need coverage under the SPDES CAFO general permit.

title: Obtain a New York appearance enhancement business license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Cosmetology, nail, esthetics, waxing and natural hair styling shops need a business license, valid for four years, with a $60 application fee and renewal online from 90 days before it expires. The shop needs liability insurance of at least $25,000 per occurrence and $75,000 aggregate, and nail salons with two or more full-time technicians post a wage bond.
renewal: Every four years, online from 90 days before expiry

title: Register a funeral firm with the NY Department of Health
authority: NYS Department of Health, Bureau of Funeral Directing
description: Every funeral firm registers with the Bureau and must be managed by a licensed funeral director who manages no other firm. Firm registrations expire on June 30 of odd-numbered years.

title: Register a motor vehicle repair shop with the NY DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, Vehicle Safety
description: A repair or body shop must be registered with DMV for each location, using the original facility application. It needs a business filing, proof of the right to use the property, zoning approval and a sales tax certificate, plus workers' compensation coverage if it has employees. The registration is valid for two years.
renewal: Every two years; renew online from 60 days before expiry

title: Register a motor vehicle dealership with the NY DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, Vehicle Safety
description: A dealer must be registered with DMV and post a surety bond of $20,000 (50 or fewer sales a year), $100,000 (more than 50) or $50,000 (franchised new-vehicle dealers). Dealers selling only trailers, motorcycles, heavy vehicles, ATVs, boats or snowmobiles are exempt from the bond. The registration is valid for two years.
renewal: Every two years, on the DMV renewal application (VS-2)

title: Register a perc dry cleaning facility with NY DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Dry cleaners using perchloroethylene or approved alternative solvents need an air facility registration (Form AFR-232). Facilities that use only wet cleaning or liquid carbon dioxide machines are exempt, and the largest users need a state air permit instead.

title: Have perc dry cleaning machines inspected every year
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Part 232 requires an annual compliance inspection of every facility running a perc machine, performed by a DEC-approved Registered Compliance Inspector, with records kept on site for at least five years.

title: License a dog and cat breeding operation with NY Agriculture and Markets
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Anyone selling more than 25 dogs or cats a year that were born and raised on residential premises needs a pet dealer license, with a $150 application fee and an inspection before issue. Licenses last one year and are renewed 30 days before they expire. Pet stores and brokers can no longer sell dogs, cats or rabbits.
exemptions: Breeders selling 25 or fewer dogs and cats a year
Incorporated humane societies, which register instead

title: Keep New York massage therapy registration current
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Massage therapists must be licensed and registered to practice. Registration runs three years, and each period needs 36 hours of continuing education, except the period in which the license was first issued.
renewal: Every three years, with 36 hours of continuing education

title: Obtain a New York watch, guard or patrol agency license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A business that supplies security guards needs an agency license backed by a $10,000 surety bond, and liability insurance of at least $100,000 per occurrence and $300,000 aggregate if it employs guards. Renewal fees are $300 for an individual and $400 for a corporation.
renewal: Renew on the Division's schedule, with the bond and insurance in force

title: Register each security guard with the NY Department of State
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Each guard needs a security guard registration, valid for two years, with renewal open from 90 days before it expires. A guard whose registration has expired cannot work, and one expired for six months or more must reapply.
renewal: Every two years, online from 90 days before expiry

title: Obtain a New York private investigator license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Investigation firms need a license for a two-year term with a surety bond. Renewal fees are $400 for an individual and $500 for a firm, with a $100 late fee if the application is filed less than six weeks before expiry, and no renewal more than six months after expiry.
renewal: Every two years, filed at least six weeks before expiry

title: Obtain a New York employment agency license
authority: NYS Department of Labor, Division of Labor Standards
description: An employment agency needs a license for each location outside New York City (the city licenses its own), with a $5,000 surety bond, fingerprinting and an inspection. Licenses expire May 1 of even-numbered years, and renewal costs $500 for four or fewer placement employees and $700 for five or more.

title: Register a commercial pesticide business with NY DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Each business location that applies pesticides for hire registers with DEC under Part 325, with at least $1,000,000 of commercial general liability insurance naming DEC as certificate holder. The registration lasts three years, renewal costs $900 after DEC invoices, and the application is due 45 days before expiry.
renewal: Every three years, 45 days before expiry

title: Keep pesticide applicators and technicians certified in New York
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Commercial applicators and technicians must be certified and recertify every three years by credits or exam, with a $450 fee for the first category and $150 for each additional category. Those who apply pesticides also file an annual report by February 1 for the previous year.

title: Renew the New York real estate broker license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A real estate broker's license runs two years and is renewed online, from three months before it expires, with 22.5 hours of approved continuing education from the two-year period, including fair housing. A broker has two years after expiry to renew without retaking the exam, and may not work in the meantime.
renewal: Every two years, online from three months before expiry

title: Obtain and renew a New York home inspector license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Home inspectors need a state license, renewed every two years with a $100 fee and 24 hours of approved continuing education. Licensees keep general liability insurance of at least $150,000 per occurrence and $500,000 aggregate on file with the Department.
renewal: Every two years, with 24 hours of continuing education

title: Register a mortgage broker with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Mortgage brokers register with DFS through NMLS and keep a surety bond on file while registered, from $10,000 for under 25 New York applications a year up to $100,000 for 600 or more (amounts from DFS's broker guidebook, which dates from 2015).

title: Obtain a New York mortgage banker license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Mortgage bankers apply through NMLS and, before the license issues, post a surety bond sized to loan volume ($50,000 to $500,000) and show a line of credit. DFS's banker guidebook, which dates from 2015, also sets minimum net worth and credit-line figures to check before applying.

title: Renew each mortgage loan originator's New York authorization
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Every mortgage loan originator working for a mortgage company must be authorized by DFS through NMLS and covered by a surety bond on the MLO form. Authorizations expire on December 31 and are renewed through NMLS, which emails a reminder at least 60 days before.

title: Obtain a New York licensed lender license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: A business making personal or household loans of $25,000 or less, or business loans of $50,000 or less, at more than 16% a year needs a licensed lender license under Article 9 of the Banking Law. Such loans without a license are void and unenforceable.

title: Obtain a New York money transmitter or check casher license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Money transmitters (Banking Law Article 13-B) and check cashers (Article 9-A) need a DFS license and a bond as a condition of it. A check casher must register each employee with DFS, and report new hires before they start.

title: Renew the New York insurance broker agency license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: A broker agency's license period ends October 31 of even-numbered years, and renewal opens within 180 days of expiry. Individual agents and brokers keep their own licenses, which expire on their birthdays every two years and need 15 continuing education credits per period.

title: Register each New York attorney every two years
authority: NYS Unified Court System, Office of Court Administration
description: Every New York attorney files a biennial registration online within 30 days of their birthday, in even or odd years depending on the year of admission. The fee is $375, and none is due from an attorney who certifies they are retired. Attorneys in default risk discipline.
deadline: Within 30 days of the attorney's birthday, every two years

title: Register a CPA firm with the NY State Education Department
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: A firm offering CPA services registers on Form 6T every three years by its registration anniversary, with the greater of a minimum fee ($105 for professional corporations, $60 for others) or a sliding-scale amount, and a copy of its latest peer review report. A $900 fee applies to each non-licensed owner based in New York.
renewal: Every three years, by the firm's registration anniversary

title: Get a New York security or fire alarm installer license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A business installing, servicing or maintaining security or fire alarm systems must be licensed. The applicant must be 18 or older, be fingerprinted, complete 81 hours of qualifying education and pass the exam unless a Master Electrician waiver applies. Fees are $200 without an exam or $185 after the exam, plus $15 for the written exam, and $100 to renew, with a $60 late penalty. The licence runs two years, and fingerprinting is billed separately.

title: Register as a New York document destruction contractor
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Document destruction contractors register with the Department of State. The application fee is $50, with $50 for each branch office and $50 to renew, plus fingerprinting. Registration runs two years.

title: Get a New York coin processor license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Coin processors are licensed by the Department of State, at $300 for the application and $300 to renew for a two-year licence, plus fingerprinting. The application requires proof of electronic fingerprinting, a $10 million all-risk insurance policy and general liability cover of $500,000 per occurrence and $1 million aggregate.

title: Register as a New York bedding manufacturer or refurbisher
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Manufacturers and repairer-renovators or rebuilders of bedding register with the Department of State: $150 to apply and $150 to renew, effective one year. Retailers and wholesalers of used bedding pay $100 for each. A fee is due for each registration category.

title: Register as a durable juvenile product manufacturer
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Manufacturers of durable juvenile products such as cribs register with the Department of State. The fee is $25 to apply and $25 to renew, effective two years.

title: Get a New York pet cemetery or pet crematorium license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Pet cemeteries and crematoriums are licensed by the Department of State at $150 to apply and $150 to renew, with a $60 late renewal penalty. A cemetery burying five or more animals a year needs at least 5 acres (waived for those existing before January 14, 1993), a $12,000 permanent maintenance trust fund before accepting maintenance fees, and a dedication restricting the land to pet cemetery use.

title: File the annual CPA firm update with the NY State Education Department
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Registered CPA firms file an annual firm update on Form 6PR covering peer review and competency, and Form 6C in any year ownership changes. The Department mails the forms 60 days before the firm's anniversary date.

title: Obtain a certificate of authorization for engineering or land surveying
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: A business entity that offers professional engineering or land surveying services needs a certificate of authorization for each service, after registering the entity with the Department. The first certificate costs $125 and each three-year renewal $75, with a $10 late fee for each full month after expiry.

title: Keep New York veterinary registration current
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Veterinarians register every three years and must complete 45 hours of continuing education in each period, including at least two on controlled substances. A veterinarian without the hours cannot be registered or practice, apart from a one-time conditional registration of up to a year.
renewal: Every three years, with 45 hours of continuing education

title: Obtain a New York food processing establishment license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Any business that makes food for people needs an Article 20-C license, including manufacturers, and stores that cook, slice deli meat or make sandwiches or salads. The two-year fee is $400, or $175 for an independent operation with fewer than 10 full-time employees, and the premises must pass an inspection with an A grade. Licenses cannot be transferred to a new owner or location.
exemptions: Stores that sell only prepackaged food (they need a retail food store license instead)
Some Liquor Authority farm licensees and honey, maple syrup and hop processors, which must still follow good manufacturing practices

title: Obtain a New York retail food store license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: A store that sells only prepackaged foods needing refrigeration, such as milk, shell eggs, meat or cheese, needs a retail food store license under Article 28-A for each location. The application fee is $250 and non-refundable, and the license expires two years after it is issued. A store that also prepares food, such as sandwiches, needs the Article 20-C food processing license instead.

title: Register and renew a New York cigarette and tobacco retail dealer certificate
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: A retailer needs a certificate of registration for each location (and each vending machine) before selling cigarettes or tobacco products, and needs a sales tax Certificate of Authority first. Renewal costs $300 per location, is filed online from September 1 to 20 for the following calendar year, and a lapse means the business cannot legally buy or sell. Selling without registration risks a civil fine of $5,000 to $25,000.

title: Register and renew a New York vapor products dealer certificate
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Selling vapor products at retail needs its own registration, separate from the cigarette and tobacco one, for each location and vending machine, at $300 each, after the sales tax Certificate of Authority. Certificates last one calendar year and renew online from September 1 to 20, and the 20% supplemental sales tax is collected on sales.

title: Register petroleum storage tanks with NY DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A facility with petroleum storage over the registration threshold registers its tanks under the Petroleum Bulk Storage program and renews every five years from the date of the last certificate. The fee depends on total capacity (nothing up to 1,100 gallons, $100 up to 2,000, $300 up to 5,000 and $500 up to 400,000) and covers the five years. A new owner must register within 30 days of buying the property.
renewal: Every five years, by check or money order

title: Obtain a New York asbestos handling license
authority: NYS Department of Labor, License and Certification Unit
description: A firm doing asbestos abatement, project design, monitoring, inspection or air sampling needs its own license, and its workers need individual certificates. The license lasts one year, costing $500 originally and $300 to renew, and changes of address, owners, supervisors or insurance are reported within 30 days.
renewal: Every year, with a renewal notice about two months before expiry

title: Get a Bureau of Narcotic Enforcement licence for controlled substance activity
authority: NYS Department of Health, Bureau of Narcotic Enforcement
description: A business manufacturing, distributing, importing or exporting controlled substances in New York needs a state licence on Form DOH-4330 after its federal DEA registration. The licence lasts two years. Business Express lists $1,200 for a manufacturer, while other sources give different renewal and lower-class fees, so confirm the schedule with the Bureau. Renewal notices come two months ahead with a 30-day grace period. State, county and municipal agencies are exempt from the fee.

title: License a child day care program with NY OCFS
authority: NYS Office of Children and Family Services
description: Child day care programs are licensed or registered by OCFS through its online FAMS system, and an inspection comes before each renewal. Owners and staff need fingerprint background checks at least every five years, and providers complete training, including 30 hours every two years.
renewal: Renewal application in FAMS, with an inspection first

title: Get a New York highway use tax certificate and decal for each heavy truck
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Each truck, tractor or other self-propelled vehicle over 18,000 pounds gross weight (or over 8,000 pounds unloaded for trucks and 4,000 for tractors if reporting on the unloaded method) needs a certificate of registration and decal before driving on New York public highways. The fee is $1.50 per vehicle.
deadline: Before operating each vehicle on New York highways

title: Get a DEC food fish and crustacea dealer or shipper permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Dealers and shippers of food fish and crustacea need a DEC marine permit costing $250, from the Bureau of Marine Resources (631-444-0470).

title: Get a DEC shellfish shipper or processor permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Shellfish businesses hold a DEC permit by class: A shipper $300, B processor $600, C reshipper $200, D digger/shipper $75 and E bay scallop shucker/packer $50.

title: Get a DEC shellfish digger permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Commercial shellfish digging needs a digger permit, $50 for residents and $150 for non-residents. Permits for blue mussel, surfclam and ocean quahog harvest, and for shellfish transplant by hand, require it.

title: Get a DEC commercial lobster or crab permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A commercial lobster permit costs $150 for residents and $225 for non-residents, and DEC lists a moratorium on new permits. A limited-entry crab permit is $30 for residents and $50 for non-residents. A lobster landing permit is $300. Check the permit page for the current terms.
exemptions: New lobster permits are under a moratorium

title: Get DEC aquaculture or hatchery permits
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Marine hatcheries, on-bottom and off-bottom shellfish culture, shellfish beds and freshwater fish hatcheries each need a DEC permit. Importing marine fish or shellfish requires a marine hatchery or culture permit first, and fees are not stated on DEC's page.

title: Get a DEC nuisance wildlife control operator license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Businesses removing nuisance wildlife for a fee need a commercial NWCO licence at $50 (a municipal licence has no fee). Applicants must be 18 or older and pass the DEC exam with 80% or more, now online and free. The licence term runs October 1 to September 30.

title: Get a DEC shooting preserve license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A commercial shooting preserve for captive-bred game birds needs a Class A licence at $200 (Class B, private, is $60). Captive bred white-tailed deer breeding is a separate licence with Class A at $200.

title: Get a DEC liquefied natural gas facility permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A facility that stores LNG or vaporizes it into natural gas, with capacity up to 70,000 gallons, needs a DEC LNG facility permit. The application page has a fee schedule.

title: Get PSC certification as a telephone company
authority: NYS Public Service Commission
description: A telecommunications carrier offering service in New York applies to the Public Service Commission for a certificate of public convenience and necessity under Public Service Law section 99, using Application Form A for common carrier certification and an initial tariff. Orders granting certificates have required the company to file the Telecommunications Company Critical Information form each year to stay active, so confirm the current annual filing with the PSC.

title: Register a manufactured home park with the Tax Department
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Manufactured home park owners register their park twice a year under Real Property Law section 233 (the Tax Department took the registration over from HCR in 2020). The current page says to register in June and December, while older RP-233 instructions give January 1 and July 1, so confirm the windows. No registration fee is stated.

title: Get ELAP approval for an environmental testing laboratory
authority: NYS Department of Health, Wadsworth Center (ELAP)
description: A laboratory that analyses environmental samples for New York regulatory programs must hold an Environmental Laboratory Approval Program certificate under 10 NYCRR Part 55. Approval runs April 1 to March 31, with a $500 accreditation fee once fully approved and an annual approval fee set by Subpart 55-3, which this entry does not state. Certified labs are assessed every two years, and labs pay for inspections outside New York.

title: Get a DEC major oil storage facility license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Large oil terminals, and vessels transferring petroleum between vessels in state waters, need a major oil storage facility licence from DEC. Fees are on a worksheet linked from DEC's page.

title: Register pesticide products with DEC before sale in New York
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Any pesticide product that EPA requires to be registered must also be registered with DEC before sale or use in New York. See DEC's product registration procedures.

title: Get a DEC aquatic pesticide permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Applying pesticides directly to a water body to control aquatic plants, fish or insects needs a DEC Article 15 aquatic pesticide permit. An uncertified person can use a purchase permit for a water body of one acre or less with no outlet. Fees are not stated on the page.

title: Obtain a New York waste transporter permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Anyone transporting regulated waste in New York needs a Part 364 permit or registration (Part 381 for radioactive waste), with proof of workers' compensation insurance and larger liability cover for hazardous or waste oil loads. Renewals go in at least 30 days before expiry, and the permit cannot be transferred.
renewal: At least 30 days before the permit expires

title: File the annual waste transporter volume report
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A permitted waste transporter reports the waste volumes it carried, by destination, each year, and pays the annual regulatory fee, with nonpayment a ground for suspending the permit.

title: Register a pharmacy with the NY State Education Department
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: A pharmacy is registered for its address, with a $345 application fee and a $260 fee every three years, and the registration is displayed in the store. Changes of location, name, owners or officers are reported to the Board of Pharmacy, within 30 days for corporate officers and holders of 10% or more of the stock. Applications are expected 10 to 14 weeks before opening.

title: Get a domestic animal health permit to deal in livestock or poultry
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Wholesale dealers and auctions of cattle, horses, swine, deer, camelids, sheep, goats or poultry need a domestic animal health permit (AI-22). Business Express lists a $50 fee and a two-year term, renewed every two years; confirm the figures.

title: Get a New York fur breeder license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Raising fur-bearing animals for sale of their pelts needs a fur breeders licence, listed at $25. A federal USDA dealer licence is needed only for selling live mammals.

title: Register a central dispatch facility for car service pickups
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A business that dispatches for-hire cars for passenger pickups, such as black car bases, registers as a central dispatch facility (DOS-1413-a). Business Express lists a $200 registration valid for one year, renewed annually.

title: Get a mass gathering permit from the Department of Health
authority: NYS Department of Health, State district office
description: A gathering expected to draw 5,000 or more people over 24 hours or longer needs a permit before it is advertised or held (DOH-3915). Business Express lists a $500 fee.
exemptions: Events under 5,000 people or shorter than 24 hours

title: Get a NYC barber shop permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: The owner of a barber shop in New York City files for a DOHMH permit, valid one year. A separate state licence is needed for the appearance enhancement business. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Register beehives with the NYC Health Department
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Anyone keeping non-aggressive honeybees in New York City, for recreation or business, registers with DOHMH. Unregistered hives can be fined. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Register funeral directors and get burial and cremation permits in NYC
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Funeral directors licensed by the state register with DOHMH's Burial Desk, and burial, cremation and transit permits for disposal of remains are issued to registered funeral directors, undertakers and hospitals. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Get a NYC tanning establishment permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Operators of indoor tanning facilities in New York City hold a DOHMH permit and must give every customer a health risk fact sheet. This is in addition to the state permit. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Get a NYC pet shop permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Pet shops in New York City need a DOHMH permit. The state also bars pet stores from selling dogs, cats and rabbits. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Get a NYC permit for animal boarding, grooming or training
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Small animal boarding establishments, small animal grooming establishments and small animal training establishments in New York City each need a DOHMH permit, and shelters for homeless animals have their own permit. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Get a NYC permit for petting zoos, exotic animal exhibits and commercial stables
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Petting zoos, exhibits of exotic animals and commercial horse stables in New York City need DOHMH permits or licences, and keeping prohibited wild animals is barred. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Get a NYC summer camp permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: A camp caring for 10 or more children during the summer in New York City needs a DOHMH permit, renewed before each summer season, under Article 48 of the Health Code. New operators and directors attend a Health Department orientation, camps with aquatics send their aquatics director to one, and staff need first aid, CPR and aquatic certifications and insurance. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Hold a NYC hookah-serving establishment permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: All hookah-serving establishments in New York City need a DOHMH permit, and no new permit applications are currently being accepted. Tobacco and e-cigarette retail stores and events may operate under a registered exemption from the smoke-free air rules if their primary activity is retail sale of those products. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Get a NYC bathing beach permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Installing, operating or constructing a bathing beach in New York City needs a DOHMH permit to operate a bathing beach. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Register radiological equipment with the NYC Health Department
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: X-ray equipment in New York City needs a DOHMH certificate of registration, radioactive materials a DOHMH licence, and therapeutic radiation units (linear accelerators) a certified registration, in addition to state requirements. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: File the annual NYC building water tank inspection report
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Buildings with a drinking water tank in New York City need an annual inspection and water quality sample each year, with a qualified water tank inspector submitting the report to the Health Department. Chemical treatment of a building's drinking water needs an adding-chemicals permit and a well that supplies buildings needs a well water permit. The DOHMH page states no fee, so confirm it on the permit page.

title: Get a photography or film permit for New York State parks and historic sites
authority: NYS Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation
description: Commercial photography and filming at state parks and historic sites needs an OPRHP permit. The fee varies with the agency's added costs and is non-refundable, with about 14 days to process; terms are one-time or seasonal.

title: Get a New York farm products dealer license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Businesses that buy or receive more than $20,000 a year of New York farm products from producers to resell at wholesale, including commission merchants, dealers, brokers and processors, need an Article 20 licence on Form AD45. The licence is annual and needs a refundable security fund of $50 to $1,250 by purchase volume, and a bond is sometimes required. Renewal notices come two months ahead.
exemptions: Buyers of under $20,000 a year of New York farm products

title: Get a NYC hotel license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Anyone who operates, owns, leases or manages a hotel in New York City and controls its day-to-day operations needs a separate DCWP licence for each hotel, expiring September 30 of even-numbered years. The fee is $350 for applications from October 1 of an even year, $262.50 from April 1 of an odd year, $175 from October 1 of an odd year, and $87.50 (or $437.50 for the longer term) from April 1 of an even year. A DOB determination that guests can occupy the rooms is also required.

title: Get a NYC newsstand license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Newsstands in New York City need a DCWP licence with a two-year term expiring September 30 or March 31 of even-numbered years. The fee is charged in two parts, $269 at submission and the rest after construction, for a total of $269 to $1,076 depending on the window; legally blind applicants may have it waived.

title: Get a NYC stoop line stand license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Stoop line stands selling fruit, vegetables, soft drinks, flowers, confectionery, ice cream or ices in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring March 31 of even-numbered years. The fee depends on the goods sold and when you file, for example from $200 for a mixed stand filed April 1 to September 30 of an even year to $20 for a confectionery or ice cream stand filed in the last six months.

title: Get a NYC horse drawn cab owner license
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Owners of horse drawn cabs in New York City need a DCWP licence, expiring March 31 of even-numbered years. The fee is $100 for applications from April 1 of an even year, $75 from October 1, $50 from April 1 of an odd year, and $25 (or $125 for the longer term) from October 1 of an odd year. Liability cover with minimums from $10,000 for property damage to $100,000 for deaths of two or more people is required, naming DCWP as certificate holder. Drivers are licensed separately.

title: Get an ammonium nitrate fertilizer retailer license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Anyone in New York who sells or makes available ammonium nitrate or regulated ammonium nitrate materials needs the annual PI-55 licence under Agriculture and Markets Law section 146-f. The fee is $50, waived with a Commercial Fertilizer Distributor licence. An inspection, and proof of inventory control and sales, are required, and late filing draws a $600 fine on a first violation.

title: Register a nursery dealer with Agriculture and Markets
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: A dealer that buys nursery stock, or takes it on consignment, for resale and is not a grower registers on Form PI-67. The fee is $100 and the certificate is valid two years for each location. It must be posted, and a first late violation carries a $600 fine.

title: Register as a farm labor contractor
authority: NYS Department of Labor
description: A farm labor contractor who hires workers for a New York farm or food processing establishment registers with the Department of Labor each year (Labor Law 212-a), on Forms LS-113.1 and LS 114.1. Applicants need a disability insurance certificate, personal background information and the terms of employment, plus workers' compensation compliance and a $75 fingerprint fee.

title: Register a ski tow or passenger tramway with the Department of Labor
authority: NYS Department of Labor
description: Operators of passenger tramways, in ski areas, amusement parks and urban areas, register each year under Labor Law 202-c. The fee is $25 for a surface lift and $50 for an aerial lift, and renewal follows an inspection that the operator requests. First registration needs blueprints, plans, specifications and DOL Engineering Services plan approval, and renewal needs an inspection report plus disability and workers' compensation cover.

title: Get a certificate of eligibility to employ child performers
authority: NYS Department of Labor
description: A business that employs anyone under 18 as a performer, such as an actor, musician, model or stunt performer, and pays them, controls the worksite or uses a payroll service must file for the certificate under Labor Law Article 4-A. The initial filing is $350 and the optional renewal $200, each covering three years, and theatres with 1 to 499 seats pay $200. It needs proof of workers' compensation and disability cover.
exemptions: Businesses that do not employ anyone under 18 as a performer

title: Get plan approval for factory manufactured homes
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Building Standards and Codes
description: Manufacturers of factory manufactured homes need plan approval for each model and component under Executive Law Article 18, on Form DOS 1280. The filing fee is $50, plan checking is $500 to $1,500 and approval is renewed every two years. It requires drawings, specifications and a quality control manual, and the approval insignia must be attached to each home.

title: File a security bond for a New York health club
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A health club must file and keep a surety bond, letter of credit or certificate of deposit with the Department before selling service contracts: $50,000 for terms up to 12 months, $75,000 up to 24 months and $150,000 up to 36 months, with more for clubs of three or more locations. It must also post a notice in two places saying it has filed or is exempt, and contracts are unenforceable without the security.
exemptions: Clubs whose buyers owe no more than $150 in total payments
Clubs offering only a monthly option within $150, a term of 12 months or less and no automatic renewal

title: Obtain and renew a New York driving school license
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, Driver Training
description: A driving school needs a DMV license, with a physical office at least 1,500 feet from a DMV road test post and at least one certified instructor. The original license costs $50 plus a $50 application fee, and renewal is $100 every two years, filed 30 to 60 days before expiry on form MV-522. A license can be renewed up to six months late, but the school cannot operate while it is invalid.
renewal: Every two years, filed 30 to 60 days before expiry

title: License a private career school with NYSED
authority: NYS Education Department, Bureau of Proprietary School Supervision
description: A private business, computer, technical or trade school is licensed by the Bureau, and renews every four years (the first renewal comes two years after the initial approval). The renewal goes in at least 120 days before expiry, with a fee based on the prior year's tuition, an audit, approved facilities, and approved directors, agents and teachers.
renewal: Every four years, filed at least 120 days before expiry

title: File the private career school financial statement
authority: NYS Education Department, Bureau of Proprietary School Supervision
description: Every licensed school submits a financial statement for its prior fiscal year each July 1, and schools that fail to file are not renewed.

title: File the private career school OEDS report
authority: NYS Education Department, Bureau of Proprietary School Supervision
description: Schools file their OEDS report through the Bureau's system every year, no later than April 1, and all years must be filed before a renewal.

title: Obtain a New York licensed home care services agency license
authority: NYS Department of Health, Division of Home and Community Based Services
description: An agency applies through NYSE-CON with a $2,000 application fee and must be approved by the Public Health and Health Planning Council before it operates. Review covers character and competence, public need and financial feasibility, with working capital for at least two months of expenses and a limit of five counties at first.

title: Register a licensed home care services agency every year
authority: NYS Department of Health, Division of Home and Community Based Services
description: Public Health Law section 3605-b requires every licensed home care services agency to register with the Department annually, and the Department may revoke the license of an agency that fails to register on time.
deadline: Each year, on the Department's registration notice

title: Keep a New York clinical laboratory permit
authority: NYS Department of Health, Wadsworth Center
description: A clinical laboratory needs a permit valid for one year from July 1, reapplied for each spring through eCLEP with the prior year's gross receipts (the 2025-26 window closed April 28). The $100 reapplication fee is invoiced with a variable inspection and reference fee each July.
deadline: Reapply each spring; the permit year starts July 1

title: Keep New York physician registration current
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Physicians register every two years, unlike most professions, and a licensee must be registered to practice.
renewal: Every two years, in the licensee's birth month

title: Keep New York dentist registration current
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Dentists register every three years with a $45 continuing education fee in addition to the registration fee, and a late filing adds $10 for each month. Continuing education is not required in the first registration period.

title: License a cigarette or tobacco wholesale dealer in New York
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Selling cigarettes or tobacco products to retailers for resale needs a wholesale dealer license, on the condition of an active sales tax registration, and importing or manufacturing tobacco in the state needs a distributor appointment. The cigarette wholesale instructions, dated 2002, give a $1,500 application fee and a $10,000 performance bond, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Obtain a New York mined land reclamation permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A mine or quarry needs a Mined Land Reclamation permit, based on an approved mined land use plan with financial security posted before it issues. Permits run in annual terms of up to five years and can be renewed.
renewal: Annual terms of up to five years

title: Pay the annual mined land reclamation regulatory fee
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Permittees are billed in August and pay in September, with the fee set by affected acreage: $400 for minor projects, $700 up to 5 acres, $900 up to 10, $1,500 up to 20, $4,000 up to 30 and $8,000 beyond. The fee continues until reclamation is approved, and an invoice can be challenged within 30 business days.
deadline: Billed in August, due in September

title: File the New York cemetery annual financial report
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Cemeteries
description: Every cemetery corporation files an annual financial report within 90 days after its fiscal year ends, which is March 31 for calendar-year cemeteries. Larger cemeteries need a CPA audit or review, and a late filing costs $100 a day.

title: Register as a New York mortgage loan servicer
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: A business servicing residential mortgage loans on New York property registers with DFS through NMLS. Business Express lists a $3,100 investigation fee and $102.25 for fingerprints, with an annual term, so confirm the current fees on the DFS page.

title: Register a professional fund raiser with the Charities Bureau
authority: NYS Attorney General, Charities Bureau
description: A professional fund raiser soliciting for charities registers with the Charities Bureau before soliciting (CHAR013, CHAR015, CHAR037). Business Express lists an $800 registration fee valid one year and a $10,000 surety bond, so confirm the current figures.

title: Get a games of chance and bingo supplier license
authority: NYS Gaming Commission
description: A business that manufactures or distributes games of chance or bingo supplies and equipment, or sells bell jar tickets to licensed organizations, needs the annual supplier licence (GC/BC-106). The application fee is $25 and the licence fee is 2% of gross sales, with the renewal figured the same way.

title: Get a New York racing track or race meet license
authority: NYS Gaming Commission
description: Conducting running, harness or steeplechase racing needs a Gaming Commission licence. A corporation's track racing licence is $100 per racing day with a $500,000 surety bond, and harness racing is $100 per racing day with $50 per day to renew. Occupational licences for everyone working at a track are separate.

title: Register a limited service laboratory with the Department of Health
authority: NYS Department of Health
description: A site that performs only simple waived tests registers as a limited service laboratory (DOH-4081, DOH-3486). The registration fee is $200 for two years, with a $100 application fee.
exemptions: Sites that hold a clinical laboratory permit

title: Get a private school agent's certificate to recruit students
authority: NYS Education Department
description: An agent recruiting students for a private trade school needs a certificate (BPSS-18). The application is $100 for two years, with a $100 renewal.

title: Register a hearing aid business with the NY Department of State
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A business that dispenses hearing aids registers separately from its dispensers, for two years, with a $100 renewal fee for 10 or fewer employees and $150 for more. Each dispenser also renews every two years at $100 with 20 hours of approved continuing education.
renewal: Every two years, from 90 days before expiry
exemptions: Businesses that do not sell or fit hearing aids

title: Get coverage under the New York industrial stormwater general permit
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Facilities in the industrial activities the Multi-Sector General Permit lists must file an electronic Notice of Intent in DEC's nFORM system and keep a stormwater pollution prevention plan. The current permit (GP-0-23-001) runs to February 28, 2028, and holders under the old permit were required to file a new notice within 90 days of March 8, 2023.
renewal: When the general permit is reissued (the current one expires February 28, 2028)
exemptions: Facilities whose activities the general permit does not list

title: Register stationary air emission sources with NY DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Owners of stationary sources covered by Subpart 201-4 must register with DEC before building or operating them, and renew the registration 60 days before it expires. Larger sources need a state facility permit instead, renewed 180 days to 18 months before expiry.
exemptions: Facilities with no air emission sources covered by Part 201

title: Register an intrastate trucking operation in New York
authority: NYS Department of Transportation
description: Trucks of 10,001 pounds or more used in business, even only within New York, need a USDOT number, which intrastate carriers can get free through FMCSA's registration system. Each vehicle running only under New York intrastate authority also needs an Intrastate Vehicle Identification Receipt at $10 per vehicle per year, and applications go through the Carrier Certification System with a NY.GOV ID.
deadline: Vehicle identification renews each registration year

title: Obtain NYSDOT operating authority to carry passengers for hire
authority: NYS Department of Transportation
description: A for-hire passenger carrier operating wholly within New York needs operating authority from the Department before carrying passengers, with liability insurance, workers' compensation proof, a valid vehicle inspection and an active USDOT number. Processing usually takes six to sixteen weeks.

title: Register as a New York motor fuel distributor
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Anyone importing motor fuel into New York for use, distribution, storage or sale, or producing it in the state, registers on Form TP-650 with a certified financial statement, a supplier letter and a Certificate of Authority for sales tax. A bond or other security of at least $50,000 is required.
exemptions: Transporters who do not own the fuel

title: File the monthly motor fuel distributor return
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Registered motor fuel distributors file Form PT-100 with Form PT-101 each month, due by the 20th of the following month, and businesses with more than $5 million of combined annual motor fuel excise and petroleum business tax must file electronically through PrompTax.
deadline: By the 20th of the following month

title: License a livestock feed manufacturer in New York
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Manufacturers of livestock feed need an annual license (no fee) that expires at the start of each calendar year, and must submit a label for each product. Distributors and retailers of feed need a registration, $100 for two years, and anyone distributing feed reports tonnage with a fee. Pet food is registered per product instead.
deadline: Each year, before the license expires at the start of the calendar year

title: License a commercial fertilizer distributor in New York
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: A company selling fertilizer needs a Commercial Fertilizer Distributor license, $150 for two years, expiring December 31 of each even-numbered year, with the licensed business name on the labels. Anyone selling ammonium nitrate registers with the Department every year.

title: Obtain a New York milk plant permit
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets, Division of Milk Control and Dairy Services
description: Anyone pasteurizing milk or making dairy products in New York needs a Part 2 permit. A plant that receives milk from producers, cooperatives or other dealers also needs a milk receiver license and a processing plant superintendent certificate, and frozen desserts need their own license.

title: Obtain a New York milk dealer license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets, Division of Milk Control and Dairy Services
description: Anyone who receives, purchases, handles or sells fluid cows' milk needs a milk dealer license, valid for a year, costing $100 at first and rising $40 for each additional 4,000 pounds handled a day up to $7,500. The Department also looks at financial responsibility and character.
exemptions: Dealers handling less than 3,000 pounds of milk a month

title: Register a professional employer organization in New York
authority: NYS Department of Labor, Division of Labor Standards
description: A PEO must register under Article 31 of the Labor Law before operating in New York, with a $1,000 initial fee, a minimum net worth of $75,000 shown on a CPA-reviewed or audited statement, and quarterly CPA certifications of payroll tax payment. Renewal costs $500 and is due within 180 days after the fiscal year ends.
deadline: Within 180 days after the fiscal year ends
exemptions: Out-of-state PEOs licensed elsewhere with no New York office and no more than 25 New York worksite employees (a reduced registration applies)

title: Obtain and renew a New York ticket reseller license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A ticket reseller needs a license for the calendar year, with a $5,000 application fee (renewal also $5,000) and a $25,000 bond, renewable from 90 days before it expires with a certification of bonded status. The fee can be waived for a business that adds no fees or surcharges above the ticket price.
exemptions: Businesses that facilitate ticket transactions without any fee or surcharge above the established price (the application fee is waived)

title: File the New York ticket reseller resale reports
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A licensed ticket reseller reports twice a year, on June 30 and December 31, the total number of tickets resold and the average resale price for each ticketed event.

title: Register as a general contractor with NYC DOB
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: A general contractor doing work in New York City registers with DOB: $300 registration and $240 to renew, valid three years. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have a NYC master plumber or fire suppression piping contractor
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Plumbing and fire suppression piping work in New York City needs a DOB master licence: $200 for the licence, $150 to renew (three years), $75 for the seal, plus exams. Renewal needs a physical exam form and a 7-hour continuing education certificate; late renewal costs $50 (1 to 30 days) or $100.
