Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have a NYC master electrician
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Electrical work in New York City needs a DOB master electrician licence: $310 for the licence, then $60 a year to renew plus $30 for the seal renewal, with a physical exam form and an 8-hour approved course for renewal. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have a NYC master rigger
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Rigging work in New York City needs a DOB master rigger licence: $200 for the licence and $150 to renew, valid three years, with $5 per foreman card. Renewal needs a 16-hour rigging supervisor refresher and an 8-hour lift director refresher. Special riggers pay $100 and $75, and tower or climber crane riggers $150 and $50. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have a NYC master sign hanger
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Installing signs in New York City needs a licensed master or special sign hanger: $100 for the licence and $75 to renew, valid three years, with a $50 late fee. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have a NYC oil burner equipment installer
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Installing oil burner equipment in New York City needs a DOB licence: $100 for the licence, $75 to renew (three years) and $100 for the seal. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have licensed NYC hoisting machine (crane) operators
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Operating hoisting machines in New York City needs a DOB licence by class: Class A $150 (renewal $150), Class B $200 ($150) and Class C $100 ($75), each valid three years with a practical exam. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Register NYC construction superintendents and site safety coordinators
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Construction superintendents register with DOB at $100 and renew for $50, valid three years. Site safety coordinators register at $100 and renew for $50, valid one year. A builder safety registration is $80 and renews at $80 for three years. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Register a NYC DOB filing representative
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Filing representatives who file with DOB for others register at $150 and renew for $150, valid three years, with a background investigation fee of $330. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Get a NYC concrete testing laboratory licence
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Concrete testing laboratories in New York City need a DOB licence: $100 for the licence and $75 to renew, valid one year. Concrete safety managers register at $150 and renew for $100, valid three years. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have NYC licensed elevator agency directors and inspectors
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Elevator inspection agencies in New York City need a DOB licensed agency director ($100 licence, $150 renewal) and inspectors ($50 licence, $75 renewal), each valid three years with a written and practical exam. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have FDNY certificates of fitness for staff
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Staff supervising fire-safety systems and hazardous operations in New York City hold FDNY certificates of fitness, such as S-95 for fire alarm systems and F-03 for indoor places of assembly. The original is $25 for three years; the fee appendix shows $50 to renew while FDNY notices say $15, and a late renewal within a year draws $25.

title: Get FDNY permits for industrial processes
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Industrial processes in New York City such as combustible dust, combustible fibers, industrial furnaces, organic coatings, spraying or dipping, pyroxylin plastics, aerosol products, sulfur and hazardous production material facilities each need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get FDNY permits for hot work, tar kettles and asphalt melters
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Hot work, tar kettles, asphalt melters, coke-fueled salamanders, portable fueled space heaters and floor finishing in New York City each need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get FDNY permits for high-piled and combustible storage
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Combustible material storage, high-piled storage, lumber yards, flammable solids and liquefied petroleum gas in New York City each need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get FDNY permits for refrigerating systems, crop ripening and fumigation
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Refrigerating systems, fruit and crop ripening, and fumigation and insecticidal fogging in New York City each need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get FDNY permits for amusement buildings and cellulose nitrate film
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Amusement buildings, cellulose nitrate film and explosives in New York City each need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get FDNY permits for methane recovery, microturbines and gas liquefaction
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Methane recovery, microturbines and natural gas liquefaction facilities in New York City each need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY permit for non-production chemical laboratory units
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Non-production chemical laboratory units in New York City need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY aviation operations permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Aviation operations in New York City, such as heliports and refuelling, need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY in-building auxiliary radio communication system permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Buildings with a Fire Department in-building auxiliary radio communication system in New York City need an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Register a telemarketing business in New York
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A business that solicits New York customers by telephone registers for a two-year term, with a $500 renewal fee and a $25,000 bond, certificate of deposit or letter of credit unless it is already licensed by a state or federal agency. The security is kept for three years after telemarketing ends.

title: Obtain a New York armored car carrier license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: An armored car carrier needs a license lasting three years, costing $300 to apply and $300 to renew, plus fingerprinting for principals. The carrier must show all-risk insurance of at least $10 million and general liability cover of $500,000 per occurrence and $1 million aggregate. Renewal opens 90 days before expiry and cannot be granted more than six months late.

title: Register each armored car guard with the NY Department of State
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: An armored car guard registers for two years, with a $50 fee and fingerprinting, and needs 47 hours of firearms training and 8 hours of in-service firearms training each year.

title: Register an athlete agent in New York
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: An athlete agent registers for two years, with a $100 application fee and a $50 renewal fee, and keeps records of represented athletes, agency contracts and recruitment costs for five years. Renewal opens 90 days before expiry.

title: Have DCWP-licensed NYC tow truck drivers
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Each tow truck driver in New York City needs a DCWP licence, expiring October 31 of even-numbered years. The fee is $20 for applications from November 1 of an even year, $15, $10, and $5 (or $25 for the longer term) from May 1 of an even year. Drivers must be 18 or older and hold a state licence with a tow truck operator (W) endorsement.

title: Have DCWP-licensed NYC process servers
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Each individual serving process in New York City needs a DCWP licence, expiring February 28 of even-numbered years. The fee is $340 for applications from March 1 of an even year, $255, $170, and $85 (or $425 for the longer term) from September 1 of an odd year, plus a $75 exam fee. It needs a roster of process serving agencies, an electronic device certification and a recordkeeping certification.

title: Have DCWP-licensed NYC pedicab drivers
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Each pedicab driver in New York City needs a DCWP licence, expiring April 30 each year. The fee is $35 if filed May 1 to November 1, and $18 (or $53 for the longer term) from November 2. Drivers must be 18 or older with a valid driver's licence.

title: Have DCWP-licensed NYC ticket sellers
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Each individual selling tickets as a ticket seller in New York City needs a DCWP licence, a one-year licence expiring July 31. The fee is $45 if filed August 1 to January 31, and $22.50 (or $67.50 for the longer term) from February 1. It needs government photo ID and a passport-style photo.

title: Register X-ray equipment with the NY Department of Health
authority: NYS Department of Health, Bureau of Environmental Radiation Protection
description: The owner of radiation-producing equipment must register it, with a base cost of $50 a year plus an amount by the number of modalities. Dentists and podiatrists are inspected every five years, a radiation safety officer must be designated, and the Department should be told two weeks before opening. Registrations do not transfer to a buyer of the practice. New York City has its own registration office.
exemptions: Practices without radiation-producing equipment

title: Obtain a New York indoor tanning facility permit
authority: NYS Department of Health or the county health department
description: A facility operating indoor tanning equipment needs a permit before it starts, issued by the state or, in some counties, the county health department, and posted in the facility. Customers under 18 may not use tanning devices, adults must show photo ID, and the facility must use the state's hazards information sheet and acknowledgement form and a warning sign of at least 11 by 17 inches.
exemptions: Businesses without indoor tanning equipment

title: Certify an ambulance service with the NY Department of Health
authority: NYS Department of Health, Bureau of Emergency Medical Services
description: An ambulance service operates under a Department certificate and within a regional EMS system, with each vehicle holding a Department inspection certificate and a certified EMT with the patient on each call. Services keep training records and an equipment failure log, which go in with the biennial recertification application.

title: Obtain an operating certificate for an adult care facility
authority: NYS Department of Health, Bureau of Licensure and Certification
description: No one may run an adult care facility for five or more adults without an operating certificate, applied for through NYSE-CON in two approval parts. Certificates are renewed on the Department's schedule, and an assisted living residence also pays a biennial licensure fee capped at $5,000.

title: Obtain and renew a New York claims adjuster license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: An independent or public adjuster license covers a two-year period ending December 31 of even-numbered years, costing $100 with a $1,000 bond, fingerprinting and five certificates of character. The firm and each employee who adjusts claims must be separately licensed, and a public adjuster who relicenses shows continuing education.

title: File the quarterly opioid excise tax return
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Registrants owe the opioid excise tax on the first sale of an opioid unit in New York, filed through Web File each calendar quarter. The return is due on the 20th of the month after the quarter ends (April, July, October and January), and a return is required even with no sales. Keep records six years.
exemptions: Businesses that are not registrants for the first sale of opioid units

title: File the monthly alcoholic beverages tax return
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Registered distributors of alcoholic beverages file Form MT-456 by the 20th of the following month, even when no tax is due. Cider distributors file annually on a calendar-year basis, and other distributors can ask for annual status on Form MT-38, which needs written approval first.
exemptions: Approved annual filers file once a year by January 20

title: File the annual alcoholic beverage wholesaler information return
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Licensed alcoholic beverage wholesalers file an annual information return by March 20, covering March 1 to the end of February.

title: File the quarterly transportation network company assessment
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Transportation network companies pay an assessment of 4% of gross trip fares on prearranged trips that start and end in New York outside New York City, filed and paid online each calendar quarter. Returns are due on the 30th of the month after quarter end (January, April, July and October).

title: Collect and report the waste tire management and recycling fee
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Tire dealers, repair shops and other tire services collect a fee of $2.50 per new tire. For filing periods beginning on or after March 1, 2023, report and remit the fee with the applicable New York sales-tax return; the Tax Department's current guidance supersedes the older standalone quarterly MT-170 instructions.

title: Obtain a DEC commercial permit to sell restricted use pesticides
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A store that sells restricted use pesticides, including outdoor neonicotinoid products since 2023, needs a commercial permit for each location, costing $600 for two years, and must employ at least one certified applicator. Sales go only to certified applicators or permit holders, annual sales reports are filed, and renewals go in 45 days before expiry.
renewal: Every two years, 45 days before expiry
exemptions: Stores that sell only general use pesticides

title: Get a TLC taxi medallion owner license
authority: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission
description: Owning a yellow taxi medallion in New York City requires a TLC medallion owner licence. Medallions renew every two years; TLC's current page gives a $370 total renewal fee and a $25 late fee, while a 2017 document showed $1,650, so confirm. An individual owner must be at least 18 and hold a TLC taxi driver's licence, and buying a medallion carries a 5% transfer tax.

title: Get a TLC medallion agent or broker license
authority: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission
description: Medallion agents and brokers need a TLC licence with a $50,000 surety bond payable to the City. The application fee is $500 for a one-year licence ($250 if issued after July 1, per NYC Business) plus $75 per person for fingerprinting, and everyone holding 10% or more of the parent organisation must be identified.

title: Have TLC-licensed drivers for taxis and for-hire vehicles
authority: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission
description: Each driver of a taxi or for-hire vehicle in New York City holds a TLC driver's licence, $252, which needs a fingerprint background check, a DMV record check and a drug test. Renew at least 30 days before expiry to avoid a $25 late fee. The licence covers both taxis and for-hire vehicles.

title: Get a NYC bathing establishment (pool) permit
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Installing or running a pool in New York City needs a DOHMH permit, either annual (to April 30) or seasonal (to November 1). The application needs a DOB certificate of occupancy for pool or bathing establishment use, or a temporary certificate or letter of acceptance, and a water plan reviewed by DOHMH.
renewal: Annual to April 30 or seasonal to November 1

title: Get an FDNY certificate of fitness for flammable or combustible liquids
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Supervising the storage, handling or use of flammable or combustible liquids in New York City needs an FDNY certificate of fitness (C-92) where the site holds an FDNY permit. FDNY lists $25 for the original three-year certificate; the fee appendix shows $50 to renew while FDNY notices say $15, so confirm. Late renewal within a year draws a $25 penalty, and after a year the certificate cannot be renewed.

title: Obtain a permit to operate a New York children's camp
authority: Local health department (NYS Department of Health, Subpart 7-2)
description: A children's camp needs a permit from the local health department before it opens, with the application and supporting documents filed at least 60 days before children and staff arrive. It needs a written safety plan and a written medical plan approved locally, a health director and staff ratios set by the state, and is inspected twice a year.
deadline: At least 60 days before children and staff arrive each season

title: Obtain a permit to operate a New York campground
authority: Local health department (NYS Department of Health, Subpart 7-3)
description: A campground needs a permit of up to three years from the permit-issuing health official, applied for at least 30 days before operation or before the old permit expires. The permit cannot be transferred, expires if the operator changes, and must be posted. The operator tests the water before the season opens and at least once during it.
renewal: At least every three years, applied for 30 days before expiry

title: Obtain a New York amusement device operating permit
authority: NYS Department of Labor, Industry Inspection Bureau
description: A ride cannot run without a Labor Department permit, valid for one year, filed through the MPWR portal at least 10 days before first use with a $100 fee per device, proof of at least $1 million of liability coverage naming the Department, and workers' compensation proof. Parks are inspected at least yearly and traveling rides at each new setup.
deadline: At least 10 days before the first use each year
exemptions: Devices permitted by the NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection and used only within New York City
Businesses with no amusement devices, viewing stands or tents

title: Get a New York title insurance agent license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: A title agent, meaning an authorised agent or subagent of a title insurance corporation paid to sell policies, evaluate insurability from a search or collect premiums, needs a DFS licence. It needs a Department-approved prelicensing course of at least 20 hours and the exam within two years of applying, though New York attorneys in good standing are exempt. The licence runs up to two years, expiring on a birthday by birth year, for $80 (half fee $40 if a year or less).
exemptions: New York attorneys in good standing skip the course and exam

title: Have commissioned New York notaries public
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: A notary public in New York is commissioned by the Department of State after passing the exam (attorneys and court clerks are exempt) and must live in the state or have an office or place of business there. The initial application and renewal are each $60, plus $15 for the exam, $10 for a name or address change. The page does not state the commission term.

title: Have a NYSED licensed ophthalmic dispenser
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Dispensing eyeglasses or contact lenses in New York needs a licensed ophthalmic dispenser. The licence fee is $108 plus the first registration, and a trainee permit is $30. The licence is valid for life but must be registered every three years, with 18 hours of continuing education each period (20 with contact lens certification) and a $45 continuing education fee. There is no reciprocity for out-of-state licences.

title: Obtain a New York boxing or mixed martial arts promoter license
authority: NYS Department of State, State Athletic Commission
description: Anyone promoting professional boxing or mixed martial arts needs a Commission license, with a $20,000 bond and a $10,000 performance bond and a fee based on the population of the venue's city. The license runs to the following September 30, and each event date is applied for at least 60 days ahead.
exemptions: Promoters of events other than professional boxing or mixed martial arts

title: Keep energy service company eligibility with the NY Public Service Commission
authority: NYS Department of Public Service
description: An energy service company must register with the Department of State, and with NYISO to sell electricity, then be found eligible by the Commission before serving customers. Each year by January 31 it files compliance information and an officer certification, and every three years it updates its whole application package.
exemptions: Utilities themselves, which are regulated separately

title: Obtain a New York food warehouse license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: A facility where food is held for commercial distribution needs an Article 28-D food warehouse license, except for raw agricultural commodities. A warehouse that rents refrigerated space to other businesses needs an Article 19 license instead.

title: Register a vehicle dismantler or salvage business with the NY DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, Vehicle Safety
description: Every vehicle dismantler, salvage pool, mobile car crusher and itinerant vehicle collector must register with DMV, with a permanent business location, local approval and air conditioning refrigerant recovery equipment. The regulation sets a $50 annual fee but DMV's summary mentions a two-year fee, so confirm the term and amount.

title: Obtain NYSDOT authority to operate a moving company
authority: NYS Department of Transportation
description: A household goods mover needs NYSDOT authority through the Carrier Certification System, with at least two years of qualifying experience, a place of business in New York, liability, property damage and cargo insurance on Form E, workers' compensation proof, a filed tariff and a safety class. A probationary certificate comes after a 30-day protest period, and a permanent one after at least six months.

title: Register a securities broker-dealer with the NY Attorney General
authority: NYS Attorney General, Investor Protection Bureau
description: FINRA member broker-dealers renew annually at year end through CRD. Non-FINRA broker-dealer registrations renew four years after the effective date on the fee receipt.
deadline: FINRA: at year end through CRD; non-FINRA: four years after the effective date

title: Register and renew a New York investment adviser
authority: NYS Attorney General, Investor Protection Bureau
description: An investment adviser with more than five New York clients registers through CRD/IARD and renews each year for the calendar year, with a $200 fee. Form ADV updates are due within 90 days after the fiscal year ends, and federally covered advisers make a notice filing instead.
exemptions: Federally covered advisers, which make a notice filing

title: Register a charitable organization with the Charities Bureau
authority: NYS Attorney General, Charities Bureau
description: Charitable organizations operating in New York, meaning those conducting charitable activities, holding property for charitable purposes or soliciting contributions, register with the Charities Bureau (CHAR410) and then file annual financial reports. Exempt from registration are houses of worship and charities run by religious organisations, membership organisations that do not solicit the public, parent-teacher associations, educational institutions reporting to the Department of Education and government agencies; exemption is claimed on the CHAR410 with Schedule E.
exemptions: Houses of worship and religious organisations' charities
Membership organisations that do not solicit the public
Parent-teacher associations, schools reporting to the Education Department, and government agencies

title: File the annual CHAR500 financial report with the Charities Bureau
authority: NYS Attorney General, Charities Bureau
description: Registered charities file the combined annual report (CHAR500) every year. It is due on the 15th day of the fifth month after the fiscal year ends, with an automatic six-month extension (a 180 day extension is granted), and no written request is needed. The Article 7-A fee is $25, and the EPTL fee runs from $25 (net worth under $50,000) to $100 ($250,000 to $1 million), plus $10 per affiliate up to $475; a review or audit report depends on revenue, with a review not required under $250,000 on the 2018 form, so confirm the current thresholds. Low-finance organisations can claim an exemption on the filing itself.
deadline: By the 15th day of the fifth month after the fiscal year ends, extended automatically by six months
exemptions: Organisations exempt from registration
Low-finance organisations may claim an exemption on the annual filing

title: Get a DEC permit for a solid waste combustion or thermal treatment facility
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Municipal waste combustors, solid waste pyrolysis units and refuse-derived fuel processing need a Part 362-1.4 combustion permit, and smaller waste tire, untreated wood and used cooking oil combustion or alternative fuel storage qualify for 362-1.3 registrations. Fees are not stated on DEC's page.

title: Obtain a permit to operate a New York hotel, motel or cabin colony
authority: Local health department (NYS Department of Health, Subpart 7-1)
description: A hotel, motel or cabin colony needs a permit from the permit-issuing health official for up to three years. It cannot be transferred and expires when the operator changes, and must be posted. The regulation asks for the application 60 days before operation while the state form says 30, so confirm the lead time locally.

title: Obtain an OMH operating certificate for a mental health outpatient program
authority: NYS Office of Mental Health
description: An outpatient or nonresidential mental health program needs an operating certificate under Mental Hygiene Law section 31.02, after prior approval review, a site visit and a certificate of occupancy. Each clinic site has its own certificate, the first one lasts twelve months, and renewals can run up to three years.
renewal: First certificate twelve months; renewals up to three years

title: Obtain an OASAS operating certificate for a substance use treatment program
authority: NYS Office of Addiction Services and Supports
description: A provider must get the Commissioner's prior approval before establishing a substance use disorder program, showing public need, relevant experience among its owners and criminal history reviews. The first operating certificate lasts no more than a year, can be renewed, and cannot be transferred.
renewal: First certificate up to one year, then renewed

title: Register an appraisal management company with the NY Department of State
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: An appraisal management company registers for two years at $250, with a $25 fee per panel appraiser for the national registry and an annual roster report that must be filed before renewal. Companies regulated by a federal financial regulator are exempt from registering but still report annually.
renewal: Every two years, with the annual roster report filed first
exemptions: Appraisal management companies regulated by a federal financial institution regulator, and their wholly owned subsidiaries

title: License a New York vehicle inspection station
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles, Vehicle Safety
description: A station must be a registered repair shop at the same location, employ a full-time certified inspector, and have the computerized inspection equipment required since December 1, 2023. Emissions and diesel inspections need their own licenses, and counties at their station limit keep a waitlist. Inspection station licenses are valid for two years.
exemptions: Shops that do not perform state inspections

title: Register chemical bulk storage tanks with NY DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A facility storing regulated hazardous substances in bulk tanks registers them under Part 598 and renews every two years from the last certificate, with a per-tank fee (capped at $50,000 a site) that DEC's FAQ and the regulation state differently, so confirm the amounts. A transfer of ownership means registering again.
exemptions: Facilities with no regulated bulk storage tanks

title: Get Article 28 approval to establish a hospital or treatment center
authority: NYS Department of Health, with the Public Health and Health Planning Council
description: No hospital may be established without written approval of the Public Health and Health Planning Council, and a facility providing medical services within Article 28, including one calling itself a center or clinic, needs an establishment application with the required schedules through the certificate of need process.

title: Collect the New York special tax on passenger car rentals
authority: NYS Department of Taxation and Finance
description: Short-term rentals (under a year) of passenger cars rented in New York, or elsewhere for use in New York, carry a special tax on top of sales tax, with a supplemental rate that depends on whether the car is delivered inside the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District. It is reported with the regular sales tax return, so the company needs a sales tax Certificate of Authority first.

title: Obtain a permit to operate a New York farm labor camp
authority: Local health department (NYS Department of Health, Part 15)
description: Housing for five or more migrant workers, at least one of whom does farm work, needs a permit to operate from the local health department, applied for at least 30 days before opening with proof of workers' compensation and disability coverage. The operator must arrange medical care, an emergency communication system and a first-aid kit, and the housing must meet Subpart 15-1.
exemptions: Farms that do not house migrant workers, or house fewer than five

title: Certify a New York farmer to use restricted use pesticides
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A farmer who buys or uses a restricted use pesticide on their own farmland needs private applicator certification, through a $100 exam fee and a $25 certification fee, with a $5 fee for a secondary applicator on the same farm. The card lasts five years and recertification is by credits or exam, with a six-credit penalty if completed more than 90 days late.
exemptions: Farms that use only general use pesticides
Work on land not owned or leased by the applicator, which needs commercial certification

title: Register a drug wholesaler or manufacturer with the NY State Education Department
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: A business wholesaling or manufacturing drugs must be registered with the Board of Pharmacy for its address, with an $825 application fee and $520 every three years, filed 8 to 12 weeks before opening. Out-of-state firms shipping prescription drugs into New York must register as well, except for isolated sales under $10,000 a year.

title: Charter a New York museum with the Board of Regents
authority: NYS Board of Regents, State Education Department
description: A museum with collections petitions the Regents for a provisional charter of up to five years, then an absolute charter, which also counts as registration. Registration needs at least five years of existence and sufficient resources, and the words museum and library are restricted to chartered institutions. The petition requires a $60 check payable to the New York State Education Department.

title: Register with the NY Department of Labor to bid on or perform public work
authority: NYS Department of Labor, Bureau of Public Work
description: Contractors and subcontractors that bid on or perform construction work on public work projects, or on private projects covered by Article 8 of the Labor Law, must be on the state's contractor registry. Register before bidding or starting new covered work, and confirm that subcontractors are registered. The page does not state a fee or renewal period, so confirm both on the registry page.
exemptions: Work that is neither public work nor a private project covered by Article 8

title: File certified payroll electronically for NY public work
authority: NYS Department of Labor, Bureau of Public Work
description: Since December 31, 2025, contractors and subcontractors on Article 8 projects must submit certified payroll records electronically through the Certified Payroll portal in MPWR. Prevailing wage rates apply to the workers on those projects.
exemptions: Contractors with no public work or Article 8 project

title: Get construction stormwater permit coverage before disturbing soil in New York
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Construction that disturbs one acre or more of soil needs coverage under the DEC's SPDES construction stormwater general permit (GP-0-25-001) before work starts, by electronic notice of intent. Coverage does not renew automatically, so request continued coverage before it ends. Plan for at least 5 business days before earth disturbance, which can stretch to 60 business days if DEC requires a full SWPPP review. DEC bills an annual regulatory fee, quoted at $110 in a 2026 authorisation letter, so confirm the current amount. Disturbing more than five acres at once has an extra requirement.
exemptions: Projects disturbing under one acre

title: Get a NY elevator contractor license
authority: NYS Department of Labor
description: The business must own or employ a New York licensed elevator mechanic to license an elevator contractor. The licence is issued to the business entity, costs $600 and renews every two years. It requires $1 million minimum general liability, personal injury and property damage cover, plus workers' compensation and disability insurance.

title: Get PSC confirmation of a cable television franchise
authority: NYS Public Service Commission
description: A cable franchise from a municipality is not effective until the Public Service Commission confirms it, by a transmittal letter and a completed application for a certificate of confirmation. The PSC may hold a hearing or grant a conditional certificate.

title: Register a bottle bill redemption center with DEC
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: A redemption center that pays refund value on empty beverage containers, or collects them for dealers or distributors, files the 6 NYCRR Part 367 notification form with DEC. Registration is free and takes about 30 days. Proof of compliance with local zoning and business requirements goes with the application, and a redemption warning sign must be posted.

title: File the facade inspection report for a building over six stories
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Owners of New York City buildings higher than six stories must have the exterior walls inspected by a qualified professional every five years and file a technical report in DOB NOW: Safety. Cycle 10 windows depend on the last digit of the block number: sub-cycle A (4, 5, 6, 9) February 21, 2025 to February 21, 2027; B (0, 7, 8) February 21, 2026 to February 21, 2028; C (1, 2, 3) February 21, 2027 to February 21, 2029. The filing fee is $425 ($305 to extend repairs). Late filing costs $1,000 a month and failing to file $5,000 a year. Confirm the fees and any Local Law 11 changes on DOB's page.
exemptions: Buildings six stories or lower

title: File the annual boiler inspection report with DOB
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Owners of boilers in New York City have each boiler inspected every calendar year and the report filed in DOB NOW: Safety, with a $30 fee per boiler report. DOB's compliance page gives 14 days from the inspection (late filings accepted to January 14), while its fee page and the low-pressure page say 45 days, so confirm. Late filing within 12 months costs $50 a month per boiler, up to $600, and filing later than that draws a $1,000 failure-to-file penalty.
exemptions: Buildings with no boiler

title: File elevator inspection and test reports with DOB
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Owners of elevators in New York City hire an approved inspection agency not affiliated with the maintenance firm, and the agency files the periodic inspection report (14 days from the inspection, cut-off January 14) and Category 1 test report (21 days, cut-off January 21) in DOB NOW: Safety. Defects must be corrected within 90 days and filed within 14 days of correction. In commercial and mixed-use buildings failing to file a Category 3 or 5 report within twelve months draws $5,000 per elevator. Older DOB material says 60 days for Category 1, so confirm the deadline.
exemptions: Buildings with no elevator

title: Register cooling towers with the NYC Health Department
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Owners and property managers with cooling towers, fluid coolers or evaporative condensers register each one through the DOHMH Cooling Tower Registration portal before it operates (Local Law 77 of 2015), enrolling in the electronic tracking system first, and keep a maintenance plan for each system. Notify the city within 30 days of removing or stopping a tower. The statute allows fees set by rule, which I did not find, and failure to register is a major violation up to $10,000.
exemptions: Buildings with no cooling tower, fluid cooler or evaporative condenser

title: File the cooling tower annual certification with DOHMH
authority: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
description: Owners certify each year that every registered cooling tower was inspected, tested, cleaned and disinfected, with corrective actions documented, through the Cooling Tower Registration Portal by November 1. The city sends a reminder at least 30 days ahead, and missing it is a major violation up to $10,000.
exemptions: Buildings with no registered cooling tower

title: Get a place of assembly certificate of operation from DOB
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: A New York City premises where 75 or more members of the public gather indoors, or 200 or more outdoors, for religious, recreational, educational, political or social purposes, or to eat or drink, needs a Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation, applied for in DOB NOW: Build after a DOB inspection. It is issued for one year, and within that year the place must obtain an FDNY public assembly permit. No fee is stated on the page.
exemptions: Premises under 75 people indoors and 200 outdoors

title: Get an FDNY public assembly permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Maintaining or operating a place of assembly needs an FDNY public assembly permit, for up to one year and renewed on the results of annual inspections. The fee varies with the number of occupants. It needs the DOB certificate of operation, DOB-approved floor or seating plans and certificates of fitness S-95, F-03 and F-04 as applicable, plus F-01 if required.
exemptions: Premises under 75 people indoors and 200 outdoors

title: File an FDNY fire alarm system application
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Designing, approving and installing a fire alarm system in New York City needs an FDNY fire alarm application, filed online by the owner, a contractor or a licensed professional, with plans sealed by a New York State registered engineer or architect. The new application fee is $420, plus $525 for a complex technical analysis when required, and $585 to withdraw. It needs the certificate of occupancy or approved Schedule A, a TM-1, floor plans, riser diagram and an I/O matrix, and installation by a licensed master electrician with an S97 certificate. A project authorization is requested before construction.

title: Get an FDNY commercial cooking systems permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Operating commercial cooking systems in New York City needs an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY motor fuel dispensing facility permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Operating a motor fuel dispensing facility in New York City needs an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY repair garage permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Operating a repair garage in New York City needs an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY dry cleaning facility permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Operating a dry cleaning facility in New York City needs an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get FDNY permits for hazardous and combustible materials
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Manufacturing, storing, handling, using or transporting hazardous or combustible materials in New York City, such as compressed gases, cryogenic fluids, flammable and combustible liquids and liquefied petroleum gas, needs the matching FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY open flame permit
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Using open flames, for example by food vendors, needs an FDNY permit at $210 per set-up or vendor, with a business certificate and certificates of fitness such as F-03 and S-95. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get FDNY permits for special effects, fireworks and pyrotechnics
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Producing special effects, fireworks or pyrotechnic displays in New York City needs the matching FDNY permit and certificates of fitness. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get an FDNY permit for tires and tire rebuilding
authority: Fire Department of the City of New York
description: Storing tires or scrap tires, or running a tire-rebuilding plant, in New York City needs an FDNY permit. Permits required by the Fire Code are paid for before they are issued, on FDNY Business, and the issued permit stays on the premises. Fees and terms are on the permit page.

title: Get a New York firearms dealer licence
authority: Local licensing officer, under NYS Penal Law 400.00
description: A business that sells pistols, revolvers, assault weapons or large-capacity magazines needs a state dealer licence under Penal Law 400.00, applied for with the local licensing officer in the city or county. Sellers of rifles and shotguns only are not required to hold the state licence. Licensed dealers and gunsmiths must also follow General Business Law Article 39-BB: electronic ammunition transaction records, secure storage and alarm standards, employee training within 30 days of hire and yearly, and a posted firearms warning notice.
exemptions: Sporting goods stores that do not sell firearms
Sellers of rifles and shotguns only, for the state licence

title: Certify compliance each year to the NY State Police as a gun dealer
authority: New York State Police
description: Licensed firearm dealers and gunsmiths email a compliance certification under General Business Law Article 39-BB to the State Police by January 31 each year. The first was due January 31, 2024.
exemptions: Businesses without a dealer or gunsmith licence

title: Get an SLA permit to serve alcohol in a college course
authority: NYS State Liquor Authority
description: An institution of higher education authorised by the State Education Department needs this annual permit to serve alcohol to students 21 or older in a class where tasting is a required part of the course. The permit is $256 plus a $20 filing fee, needs a course description, and a warehouse permit if alcohol is stored outside the classroom. Renewal notices come three months ahead.

title: Get Department of State approval for a real estate qualifying course
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: Colleges, vocational schools, real estate boards and professional societies offering qualifying courses for real estate salespersons, brokers and appraisers need approval. The application is $300 for sales and broker courses, with $25 per teacher ($50 for appraiser teachers) and $150 per branch office. It needs a course outline, teacher resumes, NYSED business school registration and curriculum approval, and renews yearly.

title: Get an omnibus operating license to run small tour buses in state parks
authority: NYS Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation
description: Operators of small tour buses carrying up to 16 passengers need this annual licence to use State Parkways and the park parking lots reserved for tour buses. It needs a schedule of fares and a certificate of insurance and is renewed each spring. The page lists two fees, $150 and $275, without saying which applies to this class, so confirm.

title: Obtain a New York sales finance company license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Under Banking Law section 492, a business that buys retail instalment contracts, for example from car dealers, needs a sales finance company licence from the Superintendent. Apply through NMLS. Licensees file an annual report with DFS in March; the last date DFS posted was March 17, 2025, so confirm the current one. Fees are on separate DFS fee pages.

title: Obtain a New York premium finance agency license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Anyone other than a lending institution or an authorised insurer who finances insurance premiums needs a premium finance agency licence under Article 12-B of the Banking Law. Apply through NMLS. DFS posts an annual report deadline in early February, last posted as February 2, 2025, so confirm the current date and the fees on the DFS pages.

title: Get a New York pet dealer license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: A facility selling nine or more dogs or cats a year needs an Article 26-A pet dealer licence, inspected before issue and renewed yearly; apply at least 30 days before the current one ends. Humane societies, shelters and rescues must be licensed from December 15, 2025. Pet stores can no longer be licensed to sell dogs, cats or rabbits under the Puppy Mill Pipeline Act. The application fee is reported as $25 to $150 depending on volume and page, so confirm it.
exemptions: Breeders selling under 25 dogs and cats a year born and raised at their home

title: Get a DEC commercial food fishing license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation, Marine Permit Office
description: Commercial fishing for food fish in marine waters needs a DEC licence from the Marine Permit Office, subject to limited-entry rules. The statutory base fee is $250 for a New York resident and $1,250 for a non-resident, though one DEC page shows $500 for a related permit, so confirm the amount. The licence expires every December 31.

title: Get a DEC party or charter boat license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation, Marine Permit Office
description: The owner or operator of a party or charter boat that takes anglers out for hire needs a DEC licence, $250 a year under ECL 13-0336, plus the recreational marine fishing registration. It expires every December 31.

title: Register a NYC site safety manager
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Site safety managers on larger New York City construction sites register with DOB at $300 and renew for $150, valid three years, with written and practical exams. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Register a NYC special inspection agency
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Agencies performing special inspections in New York City register with DOB at $200 and renew for $90, valid three years. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have NYC licensed welders
authority: NYC Department of Buildings
description: Welding in New York City needs a DOB welder licence: $50 for the licence and $45 to renew, valid three years, with a $330 background investigation fee. Fees are from DOB's licensing fee chart dated November 2022, so confirm the current amounts.

title: Have DCWP-licensed NYC horse drawn cab drivers
authority: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
description: Each horse drawn cab driver in New York City needs a DCWP licence, expiring May 31 of even-numbered years. The fee is $30 for applications from June 1 of an even year, $23, $15, and $8 (or $38 for the longer term) from December 1 of an odd year. It needs the horse drawn cab operator's course certificate, a recommending certificate and a character and fitness certification, and drivers must be 18 or older.

title: Get a New York bail enforcement agent license
authority: NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services
description: No one may act or advertise as a bail enforcement agent without a Department of State licence under General Business Law Article 7. Requirements are age 25 or older, qualifying experience (three years in certain police or investigator roles, or 20 years as a police officer), at least 25 hours of approved training, fingerprints, and a $500,000 surety bond.

title: Register a boat dealer or yacht broker with DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles
description: DMV regulates businesses selling motorized boats and brokering sales between buyers and sellers, as dealers and yacht brokers. Fees and bond terms are on the DMV application.

title: Get a New York mold assessment or remediation contractor license
authority: NYS Department of Labor
description: It is unlawful for a contractor to perform or advertise mold assessment, or mold remediation, without the matching licence from the Commissioner of Labor under Labor Law Article 32. Assessment and remediation are separate licences, and the Commissioner can fine up to $2,000 for a first violation and $10,000 for each later one. The DOL pages reviewed did not state fees or the licence term, so confirm them with DOL.

title: Get an OPWDD operating certificate for a developmental disabilities program
authority: NYS Office for People With Developmental Disabilities
description: Residential and other programs for people with developmental disabilities need an operating certificate from OPWDD's Division of Quality Improvement, issued for up to three years. A new family care home sends its certification request, with the notarised LS-22 application, at least 30 days before opening, after training, a home study and a safety inspection. The pages reviewed did not state a fee.

title: Register a salvage pool or itinerant vehicle collector with DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles
description: Salvage pools that sell junk or salvage vehicles or major components for owners or insurers, and itinerant vehicle collectors who acquire inoperable vehicles and sell them to dismantlers and scrap processors, are DMV-regulated businesses. Scrap collectors and scrap processors that buy vehicles are regulated in the same group.

title: Register a wholesale motor vehicle dealer with DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles
description: A dealer that buys and sells motor vehicles, motorcycles or trailers only at wholesale is a separate DMV dealer category from retail. Dealers file the VS-1D application and, unless exempt, a dealer bond under Vehicle and Traffic Law 415(6-b); dealers selling only trailers, motorcycles, vehicles over 10,000 pounds, ATVs, boats, snowmobiles or limited use vehicles are exempt from the bond.
exemptions: Dealers selling only trailers, motorcycles, vehicles over 10,000 pounds, ATVs, boats, snowmobiles and limited use vehicles are exempt from the bond

title: Certify a bottled or bulk water facility with the NY Department of Health
authority: NYS Department of Health, Bottled and Bulk Water Program
description: Bottled or bulk water sold or delivered for drinking or food preparation must be certified by the Department under 10 NYCRR Subpart 5-6. The application needs an engineering drawing of the source and facility, a sanitation and operations report, label samples and water quality data, and a written recall plan is required. Certification lapses if renewal requirements are missed.

title: Register as an apparel manufacturer or contractor with the NY Department of Labor
authority: NYS Department of Labor
description: Any firm that produces garments or garment accessories in New York must register under Labor Law Article 12A each year by January 15, on Form LS-154 through MPWR. A retailer that works directly with a contractor to produce garments counts as a manufacturer. Registration requires workers' compensation and disability insurance, unemployment insurance coverage and payment of outstanding civil penalties. The page does not state the fee.

title: Register a model management company under the Fashion Workers Act
authority: NYS Department of Labor
description: Model management companies working in New York register with the Department of Labor under the Fashion Workers Act. The registration fee is $500 for five or fewer employees and $700 for more; companies with more than five employees upload a $50,000 surety bond. Registration renews every two calendar years, at least 90 days before expiry, and the number goes in advertising and contracts.
exemptions: Out-of-state companies licensed elsewhere under equal or stricter rules, with no New York office or clients, may seek an exemption

title: File the annual BSA/AML transaction monitoring certification with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: DFS-regulated banks submit the certification (Part 504) by April 15 each year for the prior calendar year, through the DFS Portal. Only the form is filed; the supporting records must be kept.
exemptions: Institutions not regulated by DFS, such as national banks

title: File the January ATM Safety Act report with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Banks operating covered ATM facilities certify compliance with the ATM Safety Act twice a year, by January 15 and July 15, noting any variances or exemptions.
exemptions: Banks without covered ATM facilities

title: File the July ATM Safety Act report with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Banks operating covered ATM facilities certify compliance with the ATM Safety Act twice a year, by January 15 and July 15, noting any variances or exemptions.
exemptions: Banks without covered ATM facilities

title: Have a licensed landscape architect, licensed through NYSED
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Practising landscape architecture or using the title landscape architect requires a New York licence, except in certain exempt settings. The licence and first registration fee is $294, or $399 for applicants licensed after ten years of lawful practice elsewhere; confirm the registration period and renewal fee on the NYSED page.
exemptions: Certain exempt settings listed by NYSED

title: Get an Article 5-A slaughterhouse or meat processing license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Slaughtering and processing poultry, red meat animals and other livestock for sale needs an Article 5-A establishment licence. The application needs a zoning letter, a floor plan, water tests where applicable and a checklist, and a preoperative inspection comes first. Small on-farm poultry producers can claim the 1,000 bird exemption by registering, with sales limited to end users. The fee is on the application, so confirm it.
exemptions: Producers of up to 1,000 birds registering for the on-farm poultry exemption

title: Get an Article 5-C disposal plant license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: A plant that processes dead animals or inedible meat for non-human use needs an Article 5-C disposal plant licence. For-hire transport of unprocessed animal bodies or inedible meat needs a separate Article 5-C transportation service licence.

title: Get an Article 17-B food salvager license
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: A business that reconditions, culls or sorts distressed or damaged food for resale needs an Article 17-B food salvager licence.

title: Register an exempt food processing establishment with Agriculture and Markets
authority: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets
description: Processors exempt from the Article 20-C licence, such as farm wineries, cideries, breweries and distilleries that hold the farm-type State Liquor Authority licence, register with the Department instead. They must still follow good manufacturing practices, and a processor that is not exempt needs the 20-C licence.

title: Obtain a New York student loan servicer license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Any entity servicing student loans held by New York borrowers needs a licence under Article 14-A of the Banking Law, applied for through NMLS. Entities that think they are exempt should email DFS with an explanation. Pending applicants working under a temporary licence carry the same obligations, including the annual report. Fees and assessments are on separate DFS pages.

title: Get approval and an operating certificate for a New York hospice
authority: NYS Department of Health
description: A hospice is established through Certificate of Need approval under Public Health Law Article 40. It needs a general inspection, an inspection during construction and a pre-opening inspection, and proof of public need under 10 NYCRR 790 in some cases. The certificate has no fixed term and is not renewable, and the page does not list a fee.

title: Register a snowmobile dealer with DMV
authority: NYS Department of Motor Vehicles
description: Anyone selling snowmobiles at wholesale or retail registers on Form RV-253 and first needs a sales tax Certificate of Authority. The fee is $90 for two years per location, with two demonstrator registrations included, though the form also shows $120 to $230 depending on snowmobile association membership, so confirm the amount. Renewal is every two years with a six-month grace period.

title: Get a DEC licensed guide license
authority: NYS Department of Environmental Conservation
description: Outdoor guides who direct, instruct or aid others for hire in fishing, hunting, camping, hiking, whitewater canoeing or rafting, or rock and ice climbing need a licensed guide licence. It costs $100 for one category plus $20 for each extra one, after a $25 exam application fee, and lasts five years. It requires first aid, CPR and community water safety, and renewal has a 30-day grace period after which testing restarts.

title: Register wine brand labels with the State Liquor Authority
authority: NYS State Liquor Authority
description: Every brand of wine product, wine specialty or low alcohol wine sold in New York must be registered on Form B-3 at $50 per brand label, annually. It needs the original label, the federal Certificate of Label Approval, and a lab analysis, and the product cannot be sold in New York after the registration expires.

title: Get a non-beverage manufacturer's permit to buy alcohol
authority: NYS State Liquor Authority
description: A manufacturer of non-beverage products that buys liquor, wine or beer to use in them needs this three-year permit, $788. The alcohol cannot be sold in New York, must be delivered directly to the manufacturing site in sealed containers, and purchase records are kept for two years. A U.S. Treasury letter classifying the products as exempt from special taxes is required.

title: File the annual student loan servicer report with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Licensed and pending servicers submit the annual report by April 1, with the DFS spreadsheet template, a notarised affidavit and supporting documents, covering New York borrowers only. DFS charges its regulatory costs to the institution under Financial Services Law section 206.

title: Obtain a New York BitLicense for virtual currency business
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: A business that receives or transmits, stores for others, buys and sells as a customer business, exchanges, or controls or issues virtual currency involving New York or its residents needs a BitLicense (23 NYCRR Part 200), including out-of-state firms serving New York. A limited purpose trust company charter is the alternative. The minimum surety bond or customer-protection account is generally $500,000 and can be set higher. Individual investing, mining and purely technical software are generally outside it. Application fees are in the NMLS checklist.
exemptions: Individual investing, using virtual currency only to buy goods or services, mining, and purely technical software

title: Obtain a New York budget planner license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: A business that solicits budget planning (debt management) business in New York and contracts with New York residents needs a licence under Article 12-C of the Banking Law, applied for through NMLS. It must keep a surety bond or asset pledge covering 100% of the highest daily balance of debtor funds held for New York clients, and file a quarterly trust account report within 10 business days after each quarter. An annual report is also due; confirm the date on the DFS page.

title: Register a service contract provider with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Providers register before selling service contracts in New York and may use only their licensed name. Registration runs for two years from March 1 to February 28 of odd years, at $500 if issued in the first year and $250 in the second. It needs a reimbursement insurance policy, a default contingency plan and a Department of State filing receipt. Windshield and paintless dent repair providers must file their provider fee through SERFF at least 30 days before it takes effect.

title: Register a consumer credit reporting agency with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: An agency that reports on 1,000 or more New York consumers in any twelve months registers with DFS within 15 days of reaching that number, through the DFS Portal. It renews by February 1 each year; the annual report is a separate filing due July 1.
exemptions: Agencies reporting on fewer than 1,000 New York consumers a year

title: File the annual consumer credit reporting agency report with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Registered agencies submit the annual report by July 1 each year through the DFS Portal.

title: File the sales-based financing APR report with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Providers of sales-based financing that estimate APR by the opt-in method report the estimated APRs disclosed to recipients, and the actual retrospective APRs for completed transactions, by April 30 each year under 23 NYCRR 600.22.
exemptions: Providers that do not use the opt-in APR estimation method

title: Obtain a New York pharmacy benefit manager license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: A pharmacy benefit manager needs a DFS licence before it begins or continues PBM services in New York (Insurance Law Article 29 and Public Health Law 280-a). Apply, upload documents and pay the licensing fee through DFS Connect. The licence lasts 3 years, and a renewal filed at least 60 days before expiry keeps the existing licence in force. DFS bills four quarterly assessments by share of New York pharmacy claims, plus a final true-up.

title: File the annual pharmacy benefit manager report with NY DFS
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Every licensed PBM files the annual report by July 1, covering the prior calendar year, with the spreadsheet and an attestation signed by the CEO or president, plus supporting documents in one zipped file through the MySend dropbox.

title: Renew a New York bail bond agent license
authority: NYS Department of Financial Services
description: Bail bond agents hold a DFS licence, with the exam run by PSI and all officers, directors and executive personnel fingerprinted. Renewal is filed through NY LINX and the licence expires if the deadline is missed; DFS's 2026 notice sets December 31, 2026. A $5,000 renewal bond covering January 1 to December 31 is uploaded with it (Insurance Law 6802), with a $10 late fee if processed less than 60 days before expiry. Agents must give principals the Bail Bond Statement of Rights and bail receipts (11 NYCRR 28.17-18).

title: Have a NYSED licensed chiropractor for the practice
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Practising or using the title chiropractor in New York requires a NYSED licence unless an exemption applies. The licence fee is $294. The page does not list a separate first registration fee. Registration is renewed through NYSED, so confirm the period and fee on its renewal page.

title: Have a NYSED licensed optometrist for the practice
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Practising or using the title optometrist in New York requires a NYSED licence unless an exemption applies. The licence fee is $377 including first registration. Certification for topical diagnostic pharmaceuticals costs another $60. Registration is renewed through NYSED, so confirm the period and fee on its renewal page.

title: Have a NYSED licensed psychologist for the practice
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Practising or using the title psychologist in New York requires a NYSED licence unless an exemption applies. The licence fee is $294. The first registration fee is set in Education Law and not stated on the page. Registration is renewed through NYSED, so confirm the period and fee on its renewal page.

title: Have a NYSED licensed podiatrist for the practice
authority: NYS Education Department, Office of the Professions
description: Practising or using the title podiatrist in New York requires a NYSED licence unless an exemption applies. The licence fee is $377 including first registration. Registration is renewed through NYSED, so confirm the period and fee on its renewal page.

title: Get approval and an operating certificate for a New York nursing home
authority: NYS Department of Health and Public Health and Health Planning Council
description: A nursing home or health-related facility is established through Certificate of Need approval under Public Health Law Article 28, filed on Form DOH-155 with a project description, financial information and, in some cases, proof of public need under 10 NYCRR Part 709. The base application fee is $1,250 plus 0.45% of total project cost for full-review projects, and processing averages about 171 days. The operating certificate has no fixed term and stays in effect until revised, revoked or surrendered, and it must be posted.

title: Get a New York brewery license
authority: New York State Liquor Authority
description: Breweries need a State Liquor Authority license before they brew, plus a federal TTB brewer's notice and brand label registration. A brewer's license has no production cap and costs $6,200 for one year or $17,800 for three years. A micro brewer's license caps output at 75,000 barrels, and a farm brewery license requires 60% New York hops and 60% other New York ingredients; each costs $884 for 12 months. A brewer's license also needs a $15,000 bond. At least 50 barrels a year must be made at the licensed facility.
renewal: Brewer's license for 1 or 3 years; micro brewer and farm brewery for 12 months

title: Get a New York distillery license
authority: New York State Liquor Authority
description: Distilleries need a State Liquor Authority license before they distill, plus a federal TTB distilled spirits plant permit and brand label registration. The initial fee for a 36-month license is $50,800 for a Class A distiller with no cap, $1,450 for a micro distiller (75,000 gallons a year), $34,000 for a rectifier who cannot distill, and $937.60 for a farm distillery (75,000 gallons and 75% New York ingredients) or a fruit brandy distillery. Class A distillers and rectifiers also need a $25,000 bond. At least 50 gallons a year must be made at the licensed facility.

title: Get a New York winery license
authority: New York State Liquor Authority
description: Wineries and cideries need a State Liquor Authority license before they make wine, plus a federal TTB winery permit and brand label registration for wine under 7%, cider, mead and wine products. A winery license has no production cap and costs $3,025 for 36 months. A farm winery license costs $525 for 36 months, must be on a farm, caps output at 250,000 gallons and requires 75% New York grapes or fruit (100% New York apples for cider and 100% New York honey for mead). A winery license also needs a $10,000 bond. At least 50 gallons a year must be made at the licensed facility.

title: Get a New York on-premises liquor or wine license
authority: New York State Liquor Authority
description: A bar, restaurant, hotel or club that sells alcohol to drink on the premises needs an on-premises license from the State Liquor Authority before it serves any, and a license is issued for one location. Wine and liquor licenses last two years, and beer-only licenses three. The application needs notice to the local community board or municipality, and a $1,000 surety bond is filed with the application and each renewal. The Authority mails a renewal reminder about three months before the license expires, and the renewal must be filed before then or sales must stop.
renewal: On-premises wine and liquor licenses last 2 years; beer-only licenses 3 years

title: Get a New York liquor store or wine store license
authority: New York State Liquor Authority
description: A package store or wine store that sells liquor, wine or beer to take away needs an off-premises license from the State Liquor Authority for each location. These licenses, and beer-only licenses, last three years. A $1,000 surety bond is filed with the application and each renewal, and the Authority mails a renewal reminder about three months before the license expires.
